name: ai_PathfinderMultiSearchFilterLevel
description:
The filter level determines whether or not a path search between multiple starts and multiple destination can be allowed to run.
If denied the multi search will be replaced by a single search between one of the starts and one of the destinations
An exception to that is when dealing with multi to one or vice versa requests: if ai_PathfinderAlwaysAllowMultiToOneSearches is set to 1 then the multi search request is accepted automatically but only if the distance criteria is respected.
0 - No filtering : all multi to multi searches are allowed.
1 - Allow only if distance between starts and goals is within an acceptable threshold. Threshold is set  in ai_PathfinderMultiSearchDistanceThreshold
2 - Allow only if distance within an acceptable threshold and the starts and goals lie (approximately) on the same plane. Vertical offset set in ai_PathfinderMultiSearchVerticalOffsetDelta
3 - Allow only if distance and vertical offsets are withing thresholds and if starts and goals are withing the same navigation mesh island.
Usage: ai_PathfinderMultiSearchFilterLevel [level]

name: ai_PathfinderMultiSearchVerticalOffsetDelta

name: e_DebugDraw
description:
Draw helpers with information for each object (same number negative hides the text)
 1: Name of the used cgf, polycount, used LOD
 2: Color coded polygon count
 3: Display LOD info
 4: Display object texture memory usage
 5: Display color coded number of render materials
 6: Display ambient color
 7: Display average size of smallest tris (in cm) per entity/rendernode (could include multiple meshes) - determines LOD distances
 8: Display average size of smallest tris (in cm) per CGA/CGF - factors into LOD distances
 9: Display average size of smallest tris (in cm) per sub-mesh - factors into LOD distances
10: Render geometry with simple lines and triangles
11: Combined objects and draw call count
12: Mesh merging performance heuristic, combined objects and instance count
13: Display occlusion amount (used during AO computations). Warning: can take a long time to calculate, depending on level size! 
15: Display helpers
16: Display debug gun
17: Streaming info (buffer sizes)
19: Physics proxy triangle count
20: Display Character attachments texture memory usage
21: Display animated object distance to camera
22: Display object's current LOD vertex count
23: Display shadow casters in red
24: Trigger Custom Render pass for the object in front of camera (same number negative disables Custom Render pass in the object)
25: Tint with Host VisAreaID      - Not necessarily the final visarea we end up in
26: Tint with Enclosing VisAreaID - Not necessarily the final visarea we end up in
27: LOD Box severity. Yellow - Red where red is worse. No tint means no LOD Box
28: Highlight Auto Generated LODs
29: Highlight Auto Generated LODs - Yellow/Purple tint for sloppy algorithm
30: Tint by skinning type:   Rigid - Red     Compute - Green     Vertex - Blue
31: Display visual state params (see e_DebugDrawVisualState)
----------------debug draw list values. Any of them enable 2d on-screen listing type info debug. Specific values define the list sorting-----------
 100: tri count
 101: verts count
 102: draw calls
 103: texture memory
 104: mesh memory

name: e_DebugVisualization
description:
Tint objects for debugging
0: No debug color
1: Color all objects within the same Zone with the same color
2: Color all objects with the same ZoneData (VisArea or Zone) with the same color
3: Color all objects with the same VisArea (stencil ID) with the same color
4: Color all objects which are marked to be affected by sunlight in the same color
5: Color all shadow casters by max sun cascade key, non shadow casters orange, and unidentified objects as grey
6: Color all shadow casters that are alpha tested red, else default as grey
7: Color all motion blurred objects green and non-motion blurred red
8: Color all objects with the same dev team ID in the same color
9: Color all objects (per chunk) that pass the ZPrePass check in green and objects that didn't pass as red
10: Color each each entity(renderproxy) in range red, else blue
11: Color each GPU-PSO cache in a different color
12: LayerBlend drawcall merging, key shows reason that mesh chunk couldn't merge with the next chunk
13: Colors all objects with green if they're of the unified mesh format and red if they're using the legacy format
14: Colors all objects in a random color dependent on their unique ID
15: Colors all objects in forward transparent pass red, else default as grey
16: Colors all objects with tessellation red, else default as grey
17: Colors all objects with a LOD ratio of 0 red, else default as grey
18: Colors all objects in a random color dependent on their Material ID
-
50: BVH - BLAS Index as a random color
51: BVH - Geometry Index as a random color
52: BVH - Tints transparent geometries pink
53: BVH - Tints BLASs Red (high detail) and Green (low detail) depending on which TLAS we're using
54: BVH - BLAS - Empty space ratio (vertices)
55: BVH - BLAS - Empty space ratio (geom AABBs)
56: BVH - BLAS - Projected surface area (axis dependent)
57: BVH - BLAS - Projected surface area (average)
58: BVH - Geom - Projected surface area (axis dependent)
59: BVH - Geom - Projected surface area (average)

description:
If > 0, overrides the slot respawn time for all slot spawned harvestables to this value (in seconds), ignoring their dataforge settings.
E.g a value of 10 would cause all slot spawned harvestables to respawn in 10 seconds.
Should be entered on the server if you need to change it at runtime, or in the user.cfg in dev builds.

description: If > 0, sets the seed for each provider / slot spawn, which is usually random, and controls harvestable locations

name: ec_harvestable.spawning_enabled
description: Enables spawning from harvestable providers and slots

name: ec_mineable.log_transactions

name: ec_mineable.stall_prevention

Shows tool arm debug state. 
Default = 0, 
Draw List = 1 
 Draw at world pos = 2

name: ent_GroupEntity.debugShow

name: entitysystem.allocator.page.heap

description: Maximum lod at which CEntityObjectComponentCharacter, disables any reduced update frequency (same as being visible).

name: es_DebrisLifetimeScale
description: Usage: es_DebrisLifetimeScale 1.0

name: es_DebugEntitiesAtOrigin
description: Debug active physicalized entities at the origin, a common cause of bugs and framerate issues

description:
Draws information to the screen to show how entities are being used, per class, including total, active and hidden counts and memory usage
Usage: es_DebugEntityUsage update_rate
update_rate - Time in ms to refresh memory usage calculation or 0 to disable

name: es_DebugEntityUsageFilter
description: Filter entity usage debugging to classes which have this string in their name

name: es_DebugEvents
description: Enables logging of entity events

description:
This is for profiling and debugging (for game coders and level designer)
By enabling this you get a lot of console printouts that show all entities that receive OnTimer
events - it's good to minimize the call count. Certain entities might require this feature and
using less active entities can often be defined by the level designer.
Usage: es_DebugTimers 0/1

name: es_DetectConcurrentComponentRegister
description: Turn on a Fatal to find concurrent component creation

name: es_EntityLifetimeDebug
description:
Toggles the Entity Lifetime Debug component.
Usage: es_EntityLifetimeDebug [0/1]

name: es_EntityLifetimeDebug_ClassFilter
description:
Filters the addition of the Entity Lifetime Debug component to the filtered entity classes (as a list of comma separated substrings, case-insensitive).
Usage: es_EntityLifetimeDebug_ClassFilter = npc, gladius
Default is off (no filter)

name: es_EntityUpdatePosDelta
description:
Indicates the position delta by which an entity must move before the AreaManager updates position relevant data.
Default: 0.1 (10 cm)

name: es_ExportPhysicsGridVoxelData
description: If set, physics proxy will export the voxel data to a file when creating a local physics grid in the editor

name: es_FarPhysTimeout
description: Timeout for faraway physics forceful deactivation

name: es_HitDeadBodies
description: specifies whether dead bodies are affected by bullet hits (0 or 1)

name: es_ImpulseScale
description: Usage: es_ImpulseScale 0.0

name: es_MaxImpulseAdjMass

name: es_MaxPhysDistCloth
description: Cloth entities farther from the camera than this (and farther than size*es_MaxPhysDistSizeScale) are forcefully deactivated

description: Invisible physical entities farther from the camera than this are forcefully deactivated

name: es_MaxPhysDistSizeScale
description: Physical entities farther from the camera than this scale times the size of the entity (and farther than es_maxPhysDist) are forcefully deactivated

name: es_MaxPhysDistToTimeout
description: Rigid entities further away than this are forced to timeout

name: es_MinImpulseVel
description: Usage: es_MinImpulseVel 0.0

name: es_SkipAttachLocksDuringSpawn
description:
Skip locks during CEntity::AttachChild when inside Spawn Batches (as they should not be needed there).
Default: 0 (off)

name: es_UpdateScript
description:
Usage: es_UpdateScript [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

description: Activates physics quality degradation and forceful sleeping for invisible and faraway entities

name: es_aggregates_debug_draw
description: Enables Debug Draw for Aggregates

name: es_assert_on_illegal_entity_access_deletion

name: es_assert_on_illegal_entity_access_spawning
description: Enables/Disables asserts when Entity Illegal accesses happen during spawning

name: es_auto_destroy_expensive_threshold
description: General threshold for physics reporting expensive entities (in ms, set <= 0 to disable to fully disable the feature)

name: es_bboxes
description:
Toggles entity bounding boxes and displays entity names in game.
Usage: es_bboxes [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to display render bounding boxes. Set to 2 to display streaming and update bounding boxes.

name: es_bboxes_classfilter
description:
Set an entity class filter es_bboxes to draw, works with substrings.
Usage: es_bboxes_classfilter = human
Default is off (no filter).

name: es_bboxes_componentfilter
description:
Set an entity component filter es_bboxes to draw, works with component id such as 'Vehicle' or 'EntityPhysicsController'.
Usage: es_bboxes_componentfilter = Vehicle
Default is off (no filter).

name: es_bboxes_drawPreciseRenderBounds
description:
Toggles es_bboxes drawing precise render bounds, as opposed to the Entity Rendering Radius which is drawn by default.
Usage: es_bboxes_drawPreciseRenderBounds [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: es_bboxes_drawRadiusText
description:
Toggles es_bboxes drawing additional debug text about the rendering or streaming radius.
Usage: es_bboxes_drawRadiusText [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: es_bboxes_maxdist
description:
Set the max dist for es_bboxes to draw at.
Usage: es_bboxes_maxdist = 10
Default is 0 (no max dist).

name: es_bboxes_namefilter
description:
Set an entity name filter es_bboxes to draw, works with substrings.
Usage: es_bboxes_namefilter = bob
Default is off (no filter).

name: es_bboxes_tagfilter
description:
Set an entity tag filter es_bboxes to draw, works with substrings of tag names.
Usage: es_bboxes_tagfilter = area
Default is off (no filter).

name: es_breaklog

name: es_check_spawned_entity_access_from_spawn_fiber

Displays the EntityId of all entities.
Default is 0 (off), any other number enables it.
Note: es_bboxes must be set to 1 also (or else the EntityId won't be displayed)

name: es_debugDrawEntityTags
description:
Displays the Tags of all entities that have any.
Default is disabled (0), enabled(1), full(2).
Note: es_bboxes must be set to 1 also (or else the tags won't be displayed)

name: es_debugEntityCreation
description: Debug log individual entities creation

name: es_debugEntityIdGeneration
description: Debug entity id generation

name: es_debugEntityLifetime

Activate (create an update bubble there) a certain location
0: to disable again
-1: to activate all locations

description: Allow es_debug_activate_location calls to stack (i.e. don't deactivate previously created fake update bubbles)

Checks pre-spawning streaming radius estimates against the actual aggregate radius of the spawned entity.
Debugbreaks if they differ by more than the specified amount. Eg es_debug_aggregate_radius_estimates=0.25 means debugbreak if >25% difference between the estimate and real value
-1 to disable

name: es_debug_event_callstacks
description: Enables tracking and storing event callstacks for debugging

name: es_default_destroy_on_never_streamed_in_timeout

name: es_default_streaming_radius_estimate

name: es_densityManagerClientLifetimeDebug

description: 1: render clusters 2: add densityclass/lifetime info 3: add area override bounds. Add es_densityManagerClientLifetimeDebug = 1 to server&client config for debugging on clients

name: es_densityManagerDeleteCenterSpawn
description: Delete rogue entities spawned at 0,0,0

name: es_densityManagerEnabled
description: Enable Density Management for Entities

name: es_densityManagerEnabledInEditor
description:
1 = Enables Density Management in Editor if also es_densityManagerEnabled = 1.
NOTE: As of May 2025 this is an experimental feature and could have unforeseen consequences. Proceed with caution and report any issues you discover.

name: es_densityManagerPlanetCenterBlackHole
description: If enabled, We have a black hole inside Planets to destroy entities ending up there

name: es_densityManagerPlanetCenterBlackHoleRadius
description: Radius of the planet black hole

name: es_densityManagerPlayerRecovery
description: Recover player when fallen X meters under terrain, set to 0 disable.

name: es_densityManagerUnattendedVehicleCleanupEnabled
description: Enable Density Management subsystem for cleaning up unattended vehicles

description: Determines operations when duplicating entities are submitted to filter. (0: DoNothing; 1: Assert, 2: Auto fixup and progress)

name: es_networkUpdateDeterministicTransforms

event logging flags

4: stats (dump to log)
8: log each event

Name filter of entities to debug, seperated with |

'<filter>' to only display a match

name: ev_debug_events_events

Name filter of events to debug, seperated with |

'<filter>' to only display a match

name: g_AIComponents.DrawFiringStatusFlags
description:
Render the AI weapon component's targeting adjustments. You can set it to the following values
f = Draws the current firing status of an NPC. Including rounds left in magazine, time left on fire request and reloading status.
a = Draws info for accuracy/hit chance and mercy timers, and a line for each bullet. A red line represents an intentional miss.
d = Draws more detail in regards to accuracy/hit chance. Requires the 'a' flag to also be set
v = Always draw the debug info, even if the NPC doesn't have a firing request
c = Draws the information about the combat ranges of the equipped weapon or the first available weapon in order (primary, secondary, sidearm) if nothing is equipped.
e = Draws the name of the archetype of the current equipped weapon.

name: g_AIComponents.DrawFiringValidationFlags
description:
Flags for rendering the firing validation debug used by AI
t = Draws the text information of the validation status.
l = Draws a list of all the validation checks active currently and their status.
o = Draws the rays that were used for the occlusion check.
i = Draws the sphere used to validate the impact radius of an explosive weapon.
f = Draws the shooting frustum to debug the friendly fire.
d = Draws the current direction the weapon is pointing.

name: p_draw_helpers
description:
Usage [Entity_Types]_[Helper_Types] - [t|s|r|R|l|i|g|a|y|e]_[g|c|b|l|t(#)]
Entity Types:
t - show terrain
s - show static entities
r - show sleeping rigid bodies
R - show active rigid bodies
l - show living entities
i - show independent entities
g - show triggers
a - show areas
w - show waterman
y - show rays in RayWorldIntersection
p - show projectile paths in projectile manager
e - show explosion occlusion maps
Helper Types
g - show geometry
m - show clustermeshes
c - show contact points
b - show bounding boxes
B - show local space OBB of entity
E - show local space OBB of only colliding parts of entity
l - show tetrahedra lattices for breakable objects
j - show structural joints (will force translucency on the main geometry)
J - show (articulated) tapered capsules
v - show distance fields (if present)
s - show self colliding joints
i - show interior grid visualization (if present)
e - show surfel visualization (if distance fields present)
p - show cluster mesh patches
M - show contact patches of breakable clusters
n - show face normals of meshes
N - show vertex normals of meshes (if present)
o - show local part bounds
O - show part bounds in grid space
q - show quantum obstacle field geometry
C - show the interpolated rigid transforms during continuous rwi checks
a - show contact area 
W - show contact borders 
R - show spawn boxes
P - show suspension info. The colour depicts how long the spring is, blue is fully relaxed, red is fully compressed. The larger cylinder is the rest-length, anything larger than that will be extended with a smaller piston visually
d - show desired state sent from authoritative server that should be matched by this client 
t(#) - show bounding volume trees up to the level #
f(#) - only show geometries with this bit flag set (multiple f's stack)
Example: p_draw_helpers larRis_g - show geometry for static, sleeping, active, independent entities and areas

name: p_max_gforce_delta
description: One frame gforce changes above that value will be reported as collision gforce.

name: p_max_object_splashes
description: Specifies how many splash events one entity is allowed to generate

name: p_max_plane_contacts
description:
Maximum number of contacts lying in one plane between two rigid bodies
(the system tries to remove the least important contacts to get to this value)

name: p_max_plane_contacts_distress
description: Same as p_max_plane_contacts, but is effective if total number of contacts is above p_max_contacts

name: p_max_player_velocity
description: Clamps players' velocities to this value

name: p_max_player_velocity_debugbreak
description: The number that DEBUG_VALIDATE_VELOCITY on PE_ARTICULATED / PE_ACTORS will throw an exception

name: p_max_substeps
description:
Limits the number of substeps allowed in variable time step mode.
Usage: p_max_substeps 5
Objects that are not allowed to perform time steps
beyond some value make several substeps.

name: p_max_substeps_large_group
description: Limits the number of substeps large groups of objects can make

name: p_max_timestep
description:
Sets the maximum physics time step size in seconds.Usage: p_max_timestep [float]
Forces the physics timestep to be no larger than p_max_timestep.

name: p_max_unproj_vel
description: Limits the maximum unprojection velocity request

name: p_max_velocity
description: Clamps physicalized objects' velocities to this value

name: p_max_velocity_from_explosions
description: Clamps velocities resulting from explosions to this value (set to -1 to disable)

name: p_min_LCPCG_improvement
description: Defines a required residual squared length improvement, in fractions of 1

name: p_min_MC_conv_test_iters
description: Specifies the minimum number of microcontact solver iterations *per contact set* after which the convergence test is performed during each iteration and might stop the iterations if it encounters no improvement (relates to p_MC_improvement). The test can be disabled by setting this cvar to zero.

name: p_min_MC_iters
description: Specifies the minmum number of microcontact solver iterations *per contact set* (this has precedence over p_max_mc_iters)

name: p_min_awake_time
description: The minimum time a rigid stays awake.

name: p_min_grid_cell_size
description: Min size of cell in physical entity grid

name: p_min_send_time
description: Sets a minimum send time for rigid entity updates (it has to send at least this often).  A value less than zero means 'ignore this'.

name: p_min_separation_speed
description:
Used a threshold in some places (namely, to determine when a particle
goes to rest, and a sliding condition in microcontact solver)

name: p_net_debug_action_authority
description: Log attempted violations of physics authority.

name: p_net_early_apply
description: 1 - Update replication before simulation. 0 - Apply replication after simulation

name: p_net_fix_time
description: time that interpolation takes to fix replication error

name: p_net_interp
description: The amount of time which the client will lag behind received packet updates. High values result in smoother movement but introduces additional lag as a trade-off.

name: p_net_optimize_attached
description: 1 - don't send physics data for attached entities, 0 - send physics data for attached entities

name: p_net_pos_d_factor
description: D gain for position convergence controller.

name: p_net_pos_dist_scale
description: Scales position correction strength with position error. When error is 0 strength is 1. When error is p_net_pos_snap_distance strength is equal to this cvar value.

name: p_net_pos_i_factor
description: I gain for position convergence controller.

name: p_net_pos_p_factor
description: P gain for position convergence controller.

name: p_net_pos_snap_distance
description: Maximum distance that object can drift from network replicated position before it is snapped to network position

name: p_net_relax_factor
description: During relaxation period, interpolate between factor and 1

name: p_net_relax_time
description: Time that PID controller takes to get back to full strength after collision/(extrapolation->interpolation switch)

name: p_net_rot_d_factor
description: D gain for rotation convergence controller.

name: p_net_rot_dist_scale
description: Scales rotation correction strength with rotation error. When error is 0 strength is 1. When error is p_net_rot_snap_distance strength is equal to this cvar value.

name: p_net_rot_i_factor
description: I gain for rotation convergence controller.

name: p_net_rot_p_factor
description: P gain for rotation convergence controller.

name: p_net_rot_snap_distance
description: Maximum angle that object can drift from network replicated rotation before it is snapped to network rotation

name: p_net_state_max_age
description: maximum age to consider network interpolation data valid

name: p_net_use_pid
description: Use PID for convergence between predicted and local state.

name: p_net_use_predictors
description: 1 - Use predictors to update physics entity. 0 - Use raw replicated state to update entity

name: p_netsync_config_window
description: Opens an Imgui window to configure values used by netcode.

name: p_new_breakable_system
description: Enables/Disables the new breakable system

name: p_no_friction
description: Disable friction on rigid contacts (0/1): 0 -- enabled (default), 1 -- disabled

name: p_num_bodies_large_group
description: Group size to be used with p_max_substeps_large_group, in bodies

name: p_num_jobs
description: Specifies the number of jobs for phys.sim.(used by phys job simulation mode)

name: p_num_startup_overload_checks
description: For this many frames after loading a level, check if the physics gets overloaded and freezes non-player physicalized objects that are slow enough

name: p_override_isovalue
description: if 1 use the cvar 'p_debug_isovalue' as an isovalue for rendering, if 2 animate between -p_debug_isovalue to +p_debug_isovalue, 0 disable

name: p_params_callstack_stats
description: Dumps a table of statistics according to params. Set to +n to collect for n frames

name: p_params_collect_callstack
description: Enables the collection of a call stack when commands are queued in physics. Default: 1/0 - depends on physics debug validation

name: p_params_validation
description:
Toggles break on validation error.
Usage: p_params_validation [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled). 
Issues DebugBreak() call in case of a physics parameter validation error.

name: p_params_validation_ae_joints_offsets_level
description:
Triggers the ae joint offset validation based on a level.
Usage: p_params_validation_ae_joints_offsets_level x
		0 (disabled) 
		1 (coarse) 
		2 (fine-grained) 
Default is 1 (enabled). 
Issues DebugBreak() call in case of too large ae joint offsets.

name: p_parse_command_queues
description:
Dump and load command queues this frame.
0: Disabled
1: Dump command queues when DebugValidateParams fails
2: Dump parsed command queues

name: p_penalty_scale
description: Scales the penalty impulse for objects that use the simple solver

name: p_physical_properties
description: AddGeometry uses the density and thickness of the assigned physical material to determine the physics part mass

name: p_plasticity_power
description: Exponent of plasticity multiplier in integrity loss calculation.

name: p_player_draw_colliding_geom
description: Draw the affected physical geometry of the player when intersecting with other objects. Only drawn when physics helper rendeirng is enabled.

name: p_player_draw_ground_collider_finders
description: Draw the geometry for the ground-collider finder(s).

name: p_player_extremity_unprojection_rate
description: Rate at which collisions with the extremities will push you out of the collider.

name: p_player_geom_scale
description: Scale size for living entity geometry.

name: p_players_can_break
description: Whether living entities are allowed to break static objects with breakable joints

name: p_pod_extents_clamp
description: Length in metres for which pod is to be performed around a query (0 == disable clamping)

name: p_pod_instance_clamp
description: number of pod instances allowed to be created per patch (<0 == disable instance clamping)

name: p_preallocate_thread_local_data
description: Preallocates thread local data on engine startup to prevent spurious large allocation at runtime (enabled by default on shipping

name: p_profile
description: Enables group profiling of physical entities

name: p_profile_auto_time_limit
description: On each ESYSTEM_EVENT_LOADING_SCREEN_LEAVE / ESYSTEM_EVENT_EDITOR_MODE_SWITCH_END automatically starts collection of the physics profile markers over a time interval (a number of frames if bProfileSwitchTimeToStepLimit>0) into a dat file for later analysis if >0.0f. Beware this uses the p_profile_time_limit and szProfileName infrastructure and overwrites the values of these CVars.

name: p_profile_island_metrics
description: Enables recording of rigid body island profiling metrics.

name: p_profile_moving_average
description: The number of frames for the (approx. exponential) moving average during profiling

name: p_profile_name
description: substring XXX to be added to the profile dump (./p_profile_XXX_YYY.dat), where YYY is a uint64 representation of the current time when saving the file

name: p_profile_plot_max_frames
description: The number of frames for phys profile plots

name: p_profile_switch_time_to_step_limit
description: Switches the way the profile limits defined by p_profile_time_limit and p_profile_auto_time_limit are interpreted by the code. If > 0 the decimals of the time limits will be counted as frames and reduced by one each time void CPhysicalWorld::TimeStep() is called; Default: 0

name: p_profile_time_limit
description: Collects the physics profile markers over a time interval (a number of frames if bProfileSwithTimeToStepLimit>0) into a dat file for later analysis

name: p_profile_toplevel_metrics
description: Enables top level profiling info to be sent to metrics dashboard.

name: p_profile_use_detailed_tags
description: Add additional tags to functions when capturing a cigProfile. Warning: May cause profiler to use a lot of memory!

name: p_prohibit_unprojection
description: This variable is obsolete.

name: p_projectile_collision_max_debris_velocity
description: Maximum velocity (on each axis) a projectile can apply to a debris when it breaks it off from integrity loss. Default: 50

name: p_projectile_grid_sampling_mode
description:
Switches between different modes for sampling projectile hits on embedded grids overlapping the projectiles path in its current grid. Default: 0
0: When getting a hit during the time step with semi-continuous collision detection. Record the time and do collision detection in overlapped grids with this time
1: Do collision detection for overlapped grids with the grid transformation at the end of the time step and perform semi-CCD inside the grid. (Behavior before BUG-50118)

name: p_proxy_highlight_range
description: Physics proxies with triangle counts >= p_proxy_highlight_threshold+p_proxy_highlight_range will get the maximum highlight

name: p_proxy_highlight_threshold
description: Physics proxies with triangle counts large than this will be highlighted

name: p_queue_reposition
description: Enables / Disables (1/0) the deferred processing of reposition requests. (default is on)

name: p_ray_fadeout
description: Fade-out time for ray physics helpers

name: p_ray_peak_time
description: Rays that take longer then this (in ms) will use different color

name: p_remesh_interior_grids
description: If set to 1, will extract a debug mesh to visualize the extents of an interior grid (NEEDS RESTART!), if set to 2, will extract a debug mesh of any bitvoxels in view if necessary

name: p_report_metrics_interval
description: If set to >0, reports to metrics subsystem every X seconds (default: 15). 0 disables physics metrics reports

name: p_rigid_body_integration_method
description: Integration method for rigid bodies (default=1): 0 -endpoint(rectangle), 1 -midpoint(trapezoid)

name: p_rigid_cost_event_moving_average_window
description: Window size used to smooth rigid entity cost reporting with a moving average

name: p_rigid_cost_event_threshold
description: Emit a phys event if the rigid entity step function costs more than this threshold. Unit is ms

name: p_rigid_gforce_scale
description: Scale the calculated rigid gforce impulse by this factor before applying.

name: p_rigid_gforce_threshold
description: Only apply rigid GForce if the root velocity change exceeds this threshold.

name: p_rope_approximate_local_extents_from_bbox
description: Switches between the approximation of the local extents from the bounding box(1) or the approximation of the bounding box from local extents(0). Default: 1

name: p_rope_collider_size_limit
description: Disables rope collisions with meshes having more triangles than this (0-skip the check)

name: p_rope_exact_extents_point_limit
description: Limit on the number of rope points at which the local extents are approximated from the bounding box of the rope. Default: 9

name: p_rope_subdivided_tied_elastic_elongation_limit
description: Limits the elastic elongation as a factor of the base length of subdivided ropes that are tied at both ends to an entity. (A value of 1 disables elongation; Default: 10)

name: p_rope_subdivided_tied_length_limit
description: Limits the length in meters of subdivided ropes that are tied at both ends to an entity. Default 100

name: p_rotational_velocity_damping_factor
description: If in [0,1) and p_rotational_velocity_damping_threshold is violated will reduce the rotational velocity to a fraction of the current velocity after one second, e.g. for a value of 0.5f and rotational velocity of 600 revolutions/s the resulting velocity will be 300/s after one second.

name: p_rotational_velocity_damping_threshold
description: If non-negative additional damping will be applied to the rotational velocity of rigid bodies if it is higher than the CVAR's value. The value is revolutions per second. The damping value is defined by p_rotational_velocity_damping_factor

name: p_rwi_break_at_length
description: Throws error if length of ray (in meters) in rwi exceeds given length. Set to 0 to disable.

name: p_send_time_variance
description: Alters up the minimum send time after each send by this plus or minus this amount so things don't always send on the same frame

name: p_show_thread_profile
description: Enables the display of the physics thread profile summary

name: p_single_ent_thread_batchsize
description: Max amount of single entity islands that are processed by one thread. Applicable only when p_enable_single_ent_islands_batched = 1 and should be > 0. Default = 100.

name: p_single_step_mode
description:
Toggles physics system 'single step' mode.Usage: p_single_step_mode [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to switch physics system (except
players) to single step mode. Each step must be explicitly
requested with a 'p_do_step' instruction.

name: p_skip_redundant_colldet
description:
Specifies whether to skip further collision checks between two convex objects using the simple solver
when they have enough contacts between them

name: p_sleep
description: Sleep X ms inside step of the physics world to simulate increased load - base value

name: p_sleep_deviation
description: Random addition of up to X ms to the base sleep value

name: p_softex_collide_against_hosted_articulated
description: Enables/Disables softex instances collisions with hosted articulated entities. If set to 2 will include both actor and articulated

name: p_softex_full_step_mode_enable
description: Enables/Disables softex full step sub-stepping mode, which is very expensive and hence disabled by default

name: p_softex_sleep_enable
description: Enables/Disables softex instances from going to sleep (default 1)

name: p_solver_eigen_fallback_on_kinv_failure
description: Use Eigen solver as fallback when Kinv computation fails (0=assert, 1=eigen fallback)

name: p_spawn_bloopers_detection_scale
description:
This scale [valid values between 0 and 1] scales the spawn boxes that physics uses to track initially intersecting spawns
Default is 0.25 (setting the value to 0 disables spawn box tracking effectively).

name: p_spawn_rate_limiting
description:
Limits the number of entities that can be spawned per timestep.
The limit is a compile time constant, currently set to (1024)
The use of rate limiting is deprecated and can cause deadlocks

name: p_spike_duration
description: Duration of physics queue spikes (in ms)

name: p_spike_frequency
description: Frequency of physics queue spikes. (in s)

name: p_splash_dist0
description: Range start for splash event distance culling

name: p_splash_dist1
description: Range end for splash event distance culling

name: p_splash_vel0
description: Minimum water hit velocity to generate splash events at p_splash_dist0

name: p_surface_type_editor
description: Enables editing of physical surface types parameters

name: p_sync_pos
description: Sync pos 0 - original point in update, sync pos 1 - after network and spawning updates

name: p_tick_breakable
description: Sets the breakable objects structure update interval

name: p_time_step_tolerance
description: Specifies the tolerance of performed timestep compared to requested timestep

name: p_unproj_vel_scale
description: Requested unprojection velocity is set equal to penetration depth multiplied by this number

name: p_update_part_gs_bounds
description: If enabled, updates the grid space bounds of each part after reposition. Default: 1

name: p_use_any_field_for_grid
description: Uses any distance field attached to grid host as a part of grid (0/1): 0 -- disabled, 1 -- enabled

name: p_use_awake_env_bboxes
description: Compute a bounding box when batch updating parts of the updated parts that is used to query physical entities to awake due to potential overlap. Currently this is only used for shadow entities for which the bounding box usually overlaps a large part of the interior volume.

name: p_use_cosserat_frames_for_skinning
description: If enabled (default 1), character attached cosserat frames will use the cosserat frames for skinning and the attachment frames are transferred onto the rod. If disabled cosserat frames and skinning frame deltas will be recomputed from the characters base orientation, a vector pointing to z and the the strand chain information provided by the particles.

name: p_use_distance_contacts
description: Allows to use distance-based contacts (is forced off in multiplayer)

name: p_use_substep_physics
description:
Toggles sub stepped physics loop. Forces sub steps to no larger than p_max_timestep.Usage: p_substep_physics [0/1]
Forces sub steps when set to 1. When set to 0, the
time step is variable, based on the frame rate.

name: p_use_substep_physics_server_only
description:
Toggles sub stepped physics loop on server only. Forces sub steps to no larger than p_max_timestep.Usage: p_use_substep_physics_server_only [0/1]
Forces sub steps on server only when set to 1. When set to 0, the
time step is variable, based on the frame rate.

name: p_use_unproj_vel
description: internal solver tweak

name: p_validate_part_naming_mismatch
description: Verifies close naming mismatches between part names and unique id searches [0/1], Default: 0

name: p_validate_selective_compounding
description:
Toggles validation of the user-switchable option to prevent compounding of physical entities during OC export and on attachment in the physical proxy.
Usage: p_validate_selective_compounding [0/1]
Default is 1 (validation enabled)

name: p_verify_parts_deferred
description:
Defers CPhysicalEntity::VerifyParts to be called only once per timestep instead of every command.
Usage: p_validate_params [0/1]
Default is 1 (deferred). Deferred verification can hide the actual call site,
so set to 0 to catch the immediate command that caused an error.

name: p_warn_about_disallowed_compounding
description:
Switches warning about disallowed compounding in the asset setup of physical entities during OC export and on attachment in the physical proxy.
Usage: p_warn_about_disallowed_compounding [0/1]
Default is 1 (warning enabled)

name: p_wireframe_distance
description: Maximum distance at which wireframe is drawn on physics helpers

name: p_wv_GUImovementhelper
description: Opens an Imgui window to debug and tweak physical movement of wheeled vehicles.

name: pfx_shake_distance
description: Multiplier on the Cam Shake Distance parameter for particle effects camera shakes

name: pfx_shake_intensity
description: Multiplier on the Cam Shake Rot and Shift parameters for particle effects camera shakes

name: ph_debug_accidental_fire
description: Display debug info for the accidental hit filtering system

name: ph_debug_hostility_component
description: Display debug info for hostility component

name: ph_debug_hostility_component_range
description: Max range for displaying hostility info of other entities

name: ph_debug_hostility_component_type
description:
Controls which hostility component types we display debug info for
1: EntityComponentHostility
2: EntityComponentHostilityComposite
3: Both

name: ph_debug_hostility_include_dead_actors
description: Whether or not to display hostility debug information (via ph_debug_hostility_component) for dead actors

name: ph_hostilityComposite_HitLogging_enabled
description: Enables EntityComponentHostilityComposite OnHandleHit Logging

name: phpx_drawExtrapTime
description: Flag to enable/disable in-world display of Time/Pct in Extrap/Interp mode

name: phpx_drawExtrapTime_Threshold
description: Pct value for how much time spent extrapolating that will change the text color displayed

name: phpx_drawPosAges
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of ages of points in position history 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_drawRightTrails
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of right vector history 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_drawTrailDots
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of position dot trails 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both. Add 4 to enable drawing of positional error between local and remote.

name: phpx_drawTrailLines
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of position line trails 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both. Add 4 to enable drawing of positional error between local and remote.

name: phpx_drawUpTrails
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of up vector history 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_drawVelTrails
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of velocity vector history 0=off, 1=linear local, 2=linear remote, 3=both linear, 4=angular local, 8=angular remote, 12=both angular

name: phpx_extrapTime_logInterval_ms
description: Interval (milliseconds) for logging extrapolation debug data to console/files

name: phpx_ignorelist_debugdist
description: Enable/disable showing ignore list of Entity / Physics Proxy within specified distance (0 is off)

name: phpx_lengthAngVelTrails
description: Enable/disable drawing of velocity vector history 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_lengthUpTrails
description: Length in of up vector trails

name: phpx_lengthVelTrails
description: Bit mask to enable/disable drawing of velocity vector history 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_pauseGraphs
description: Flag to enable/disable debug latency logging to IMGUI graphs

name: phpx_pauseTrails
description: Bit mask to pause recording of debug trails 0=off, 1=local, 2=remote, 3=both

name: phpx_showStatus
description: Enable/disable drawing of physics proxy net sync status 0=off, 1=all, 2=net sync enabled only

name: pilot_vjoy_deadzone
description: Pilots: Defines the size of the dead zone

name: pilot_vjoy_max_angle
description: Pilots: Defines the max angle vjoy is offset from the middle of the screen.

name: pilot_vjoy_visibility
description: Pilots: Defines conditions for showing vjoy: 0 - always off, 1 - on mouse input only, 2 - always on

name: pilot_vjoy_visibility_drawDeadzone
description: Pilots: Draws the VJoy dead zone if visible.

name: pl_AIVehicle
description: Enable AI control on the client player's vehicle.

name: pl_AbilityDebug
description: Display player abilities

name: pl_ActivatePlayerStatusDisplay
description: 0 : DockItem; 1 Building Blocks; 2 DockItem & Building Blocks; 3 Building Blocks (force all on)

name: pl_IdleKickWarningCountdown
description: Time a private server can be active in pre-game without starting the game (in seconds, pre-match only), server kicks all clients after this time

name: pl_ServerDisableClientIdleKick
description: Disable server kicking any client for being idle too long

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollAngularRate
description: Angular rotation smoothing for articulated entities with gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollAngularRateNoGravity
description: Angular rotation smoothing for articulated entities in Zero Gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollEnabled
description: Whether to use special ragdoll smoothing algorithms

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollMaxPredictionTime
description: The time since last update in the predictor is limited by this value.

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollPredictionRate
description: Determines what portion (from 0 to 1) of the predicted movement to apply. Larger values result in longer correction times for sudden changes in direction, lower values decrease the smoothness of the motion on remote clients.

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollQuaternionRate
description: Quaternion smoothing amount with gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollQuaternionRateNoGravity
description: Quaternion smoothing amount in Zero Gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollSnapDistance
description: If the position is off by more than this number, smoothing will be skipped over

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollUsePredictor
description: Whether or not the ragdoll uses the interpolated predictor values before smoothing with gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollUsePredictorNoGravity
description: Whether or not the ragdoll uses the interpolated predictor values before smoothing in Zero Gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollVelocityRate
description: Velocity smoothing over speed correction with gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollVelocityRateNoGravity
description: Velocity smoothing over speed correction in Zero Gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollVelocityScale
description: Velocity smoothing scaler with gravity

name: pl_SmoothingRagdollVelocityScaleNoGravity
description: Velocity smoothing scaler in Zero Gravity

name: pl_action_handler.debugData.enable
description: Enable actor action handler debug data (0=off, 1=on)

name: pl_action_handler.debugData.filter
description: Comma separated list of sections to filter to.

name: pl_action_handler.debugData.flagFilter
description: Flags to filter to.

name: pl_action_handler.validatePosition.timeout
description: Timeout for the command, in seconds.

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.maxRange
description: Range from the camera, for displaying actors in the actor state debug, see "useMaxRange".

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.onlyShowInVision
description: With this enabled, only actors within the view angle, specified by "visionConeCosine ", of the camera, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.showAIPlayers
description: Whether to enable display of AI players, in actor state debug, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.showCorpses
description: Whether to enable display of corpse actors, in actor state debug, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.showLocalPlayers
description: Whether to enable display of local client players, in actor state debug, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.showOtherPlayers
description: Whether to enable display of players which are neither local clients nor AI players, in actor state debug, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.targetNearbyActorsRange
description: Range from the camera, for targeting nearby actors.

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.useMaxRange
description: With this enabled, only actors within the range specified by "maxRange" from the camera, are shown in the actor state debug, (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actorDebugData.actorFilters.visionConeCosine
description: View angle to filter actors in the actor state debug, see "onlyShowInVision".

name: pl_actorDebugData.handlesDebug
description: Render player handles

name: pl_actorDebugData.rendererModes.file
description: Renderer mode for file actor state debug renderer. (0 = off, 1 = target actors only, 2 = all actors

name: pl_actorDebugData.rendererModes.floating
description: Renderer mode for floating actor state debug renderer. (0 = off, 1 = target actors only, 2 = all actors

name: pl_actorDebugData.rendererModes.imgui
description: Renderer mode for ImGUI actor state debug renderer. (0 = off, 1 = target actors only, 2 = all actors

name: pl_actorDebugData.targets
description: Target entities for actor debug, as a comma separated list of actor names or IDs. Special values: "0": Target no actors, "1": Target only the local client actor (subject to filters).

name: pl_actor_ability.debugData.enable
description: Enable ability debug data (0=off, 1=on).

name: pl_actor_ability.debugData.filter
description: Comma separated list of sections to filter to.

name: pl_actor_ability.debugData.flagFilter
description: Flags to filter to.

name: pl_adjustJumpAngleWithFloorNormal
description: Set to true to adjust the angle a player jumps relative to the floor normal they're stood on. Can make jumping on slopes frustrating.

name: pm_PreloadGlobalBanks
description:
Global (autoload) preload setting.
Usage: s_PreloadGlobalBanks [0..2]
The usage of this differs depending on the value of s_UsePrepareEvent
If s_UsePrepareEvent is 0 (banked media mode):
  0: don't preload any banks
  1: load all banks that have AutoLoad set in their ATL files
  2: load _all_ banks regardless of AutoLoad setting 
If s_UsePrepareEvent is 1 (loose media mode):
  0: don't prepare any events up front
  1: prepare all events for banks that have AutoLoad set in their ATL files
  2: prepare all events for all banks, regardless of AutoLoad setting
NOTE: ALL banks will be loaded up front when s_UsePrepareEvent is 1

name: pm_PrepareEventPoolHeadRoom

name: pm_UsePrepareEvent
description:
Specifies whether events will attempt to be prepared. Use this in conjunction with banks with loose media.
Note: don't use with banked media as the media will be loaded into memory twice! Once in the BankMediaPool and once in the PrepareEventPool.
Usage: s_WwiseUsePrepareEvent [0/1]
Default PC: 1(events will be prepared), NA for other platforms ATM

description: Stop the probe spawning shader (and stop old probes from timing out) to test culling behavior

name: r.GI.Debug.TraceCost
description:
Enables Trace cost profiling functionality
0: Off
1: On

name: r.GI.Debug.TraceCost.AverageUpdateWeight
description: Determines how quickly the running average of Trace costs are updated. Closer to 1 updates at a quicker rate. Default 0.1. Range [0.0, 1.0].

name: r.GI.Debug.TraceCost.ClockScope
description:
Determines the granularity of ShaderClock timings. Note that not all scope are available and some are device dependant.
1: DeviceScope 
3: SubgroupScope (Default)

name: r.GI.Debug.TraceCost.ClockThreshold
description: Threshold value for Heatmap value normalization against arbitrary Shader Clock values. Default 0.00001. Range [0.0, 0.0001].

name: r.GI.Debug.TraceCost.GeomOverlayBlend
description: Value to determine the blend between DebugViewGeom rendering and Trace cost values. Default 0.99. Range [0.0, 1.0].

name: r.GI.Debug.Transparency.Freeze
description: Freeze transparency volume to current camera location

name: r.GI.Debug.Transparency.Mode
description:
Debug the transparency froxel probes
0: Off
1: Radiance probes (front-face)
2: Radiance probes (back-face)
3: Radiance probes (2D Chart)
4: Irradiance probes (front-face)
5: Irradiance probes (back-face)
6: Irradiance probes (2D Chart)

name: r.GI.Debug.Transparency.ProbeGrid.Freeze
description: Freeze probe grid to current camera location

name: r.GI.Debug.Transparency.ProbeGrid.Mode
description:
Debug the zone-space probe grid(s)
0: Off
1: Unfiltered Front-face
2: Unfiltered Back-face
3: Unfiltered 2D Chart
4: Spherical Harmonics Front-face
5: Spherical Harmonics Back-face
6: Spherical Harmonics 2D Chart
7: Probe age

name: r.GI.Debug.Transparency.Slice
description: Which slice of the transparency volume to debug-draw (-1 for all slices)

name: r.GI.Debug.ViewGeometry
description:
View the GI geometry as it appears to the current traversal mode (e.g. ray-tracing, software-tracing)
0: Off
1: Lit Color
2: Color in light-cache
3: Direct-only color in light-cache
4: Indirect-only color in light-cache
5: Surface Albedo
6: Light-cache uncertainty
7: Random-color cache cells (or texels)
8: Random-color cache tiles (or texture slices)
9: Surface Diffuse
10: Surface Specular
11: Surface Emissive
12: Visarea ID (random color)
13: Lighting Model (emissive. transmissive, etc)
14: BVH-Split

name: r.GI.Debug.ViewGeometry.Multiplier
description: Multiply output brightness of ViewGeometry values

name: r.GI.Debug.ViewGeometry.ShowHighQuality
description: Show high-quality BVH where present (default on)

name: r.GI.Debug.ViewGeometry.Size
description: How big the ViewGeometry debug should appear on screen [0,1]

name: r.GI.Debug.ViewGeometry.TraceCost
description:
View the Trace cost for the Hardware Raytracing rays submitted for GI geometry in the scene
0: Off 
1: On

name: r.GI.EnvProbes.AcceptanceMargin
description: Extra safety margin (in meters) when comparing probe GBuffer depth against projection bounds and deciding whether to trace out of it

name: r.GI.EnvProbes.SearchDistance
description: Distance in meters that a ray can search out of one probe and into another (when using Env-probe lighting)

name: r.GI.GeometryNormalsSource
description:
Source used for geometry normals in GI
0: Use GBuffer normals
1: Use normals calculated from depth

name: r.GI.Indirect.ImportanceSampling
description: Enable importance sampling for indirect light (requires r.GI.AlternativeLighting)

name: r.GI.Indirect.ImportanceSampling.NormFactorClamp
description: Limit the over-brightening of low-probability samples (introduces bias, reduces sparkling)

name: r.GI.Indirect.ImportanceSampling.UniformChance
description: Chance of firing a ray without the importance history affecting the choice

name: r.GI.LightingRepeat
description: Repeat the GI lighting stage multiple times to get faster response (expensive)

name: r.GI.Lights.EnableThisAreaOnly
description: Enable lights marked as "This Area Only" to only affect surfaces inside their own VisArea.

name: r.GI.Lights.EnvProbeLookup.BigLightSize
description: Maximum size of a probe before it's no longer divided into cells (smaller values means less hash-map usage but more lights linear-searched)

name: r.GI.Lights.EnvProbeLookup.Cascade0CellsToRange
description:
Number of cells in the range of environment probe lookup's cascade 0 (must be power of 2)
Total number of cells in cascade 0 will be (n*2)^3

name: r.GI.Lights.EnvProbeLookup.Cascade0Range
description: Range to end of environment probe lookup's cascade 0

name: r.GI.Lights.EnvProbeLookup.CullRatio
description: Ratio to cull onvironment probe from environment probe lookup. Any probe with an extent less than this ratio compared to a cascade tile will be culled

name: r.GI.Lights.EnvProbeLookup.Size
description: Number of entries in the env-probe lookup structure

name: r.GI.Lights.HighQualityRange
description: Max distance for high-quality lighting (i.e. many small lights)

name: r.GI.Lights.LightCellSize
description: Size (in meters) of a hash-cell in the light lookup structure

name: r.GI.Lights.LightLookup.BigLightSize
description: Maximum size of a light before it's no longer divided into cells (smaller values means less hash-map usage but more lights linear-searched)

name: r.GI.Lights.LightLookup.Cascade0CellsToRange
description:
Number of cells in the range of light lookup's cascade 0 (must be power of 2)
Total number of cells in cascade 0 will be (n*2)^3

name: r.GI.Lights.LightLookup.Cascade0Range
description: Range to end of light lookup's cascade 0

name: r.GI.Lights.LightLookup.CullRatio
description: Ratio to cull lights from light lookup. Any light with an extent less than this ratio compared to a cascade tile will be culled

name: r.GI.Lights.LightLookup.Size
description: Number of entries in the light lookup structure

name: r.GI.Lights.MaxEnvProbes
description: Max number of environment probes that can be submitted to GI at once

name: r.GI.Lights.MaxLights
description: Max number of lights that can be submitted to GI at once

name: r.GI.Lights.MaxShadows
description: Max number of shadows (including fourier shadows) that can be submitted to GI at once

name: r.GI.Lights.SoftwareShadowBias
description: Constant depth-bias (in meters) to counteract inaccuracy in the software-tracing scene representation

name: r.GI.Lights.SortShadingRequests
description: Sort shading requests for performance

name: r.GI.MaterialBuffer.Clear
description:
Clears material buffer (cvar resets after clear)
1: Black
2: Pink

name: r.GI.MaterialBuffer.EnablePerVertexData
description: Enable certain meshes to use per vertex material data

name: r.GI.MaterialBuffer.PerVertexBudgetMB
description: Memory available for per vertex data in the material buffer

name: r.GI.MaterialBuffer.TempBudgetMB
description: Memory available for temporary per vertex data allocations needed when calculating per object material data

name: r.GI.Materials.EnableLightLinks
description: Enable light links

name: r.GI.Rays.Binning
description: Enable ray-binning

name: r.GI.Rays.Binning.NumAngularBins
description: Number of bins for ray-binning (will be rounded up to power of 2)

name: r.GI.Rays.Binning.NumSpatialBins
description: Number of bins for ray-binning (will be rounded up to power of 2)

name: r.GI.Rays.MaxDistanceLong
description: Default max distance for a ray (should be enough to escape the RT scene but not enough to miss the sky cubemap)

name: r.GI.Rays.MaxDistanceShort
description: Default max distance for a ray to use high-quality BVH (if present)

name: r.GI.Rays.SharpReflectionThreshold
description: Ray divergence value below which we use per-ray direct light value instead of radiance cache

name: r.GI.Scene.BVHSplit
description:
How to split high vs low detail BVH
0: Don't split (everything high detail) 
1: Two acceleration structures
2: One acceleration structure with offset geometry

name: r.GI.Scene.EnablePortalCulling
description: Whether to do (spherical) portal culling when searching for global illumination contributors

name: r.GI.Scene.FarBVHLodDistance
description: Fixed distance to use to calculate the LOD for the low-detail BVH

name: r.GI.Scene.FarBVHLodMode
description:
Mode for streaming in LODs for the far BVH
0: Off, no additional LOD streaming
1: Load only the extra required LOD
2: Load entire range including extra required LOD

name: r.GI.Scene.HighDetailRadius
description: Radius for high-lod ray-tracing

name: r.GI.Scene.OuterRadius
description: What radius to search for global illumination contributors

name: r.GI.ScreenCache.DisableReuse
description: Disable screen cache entry reuse/updates for debugging

name: r.GI.ScreenCache.MaxAge
description: Max frames since last update on screen probe cache entries before they're discarded.

name: r.GI.ScreenCache.Mode
description:
Enable cache of evicted screen space probes
1: Single dedicated entry per tile (no motion reprojection)
2: General queue of most recently used entries from the entire frame

name: r.GI.ScreenCache.Scale
description: Screen cache size as a fraction of the regular screen probe count

name: r.GI.ScreenFilters
description:
Enable denoising of the final screenspace GI
0 - Off
1 - On

name: r.GI.ScreenFilters.Accumulate
description: Enable temporal accumulation of final screenspace GI

name: r.GI.ScreenFilters.Denoise
description: Enable spatial denoising of final screenspace GI

name: r.GI.ScreenLighting
description:
Whether to enable screen-space lighting for in-view ray hits
0: Off
1: Used for screen-trace hits only
2: Used for screen-trace hits and specular surface rays
3: Used for screen-trace hits and spec+diffuse surface rays

name: r.GI.ScreenLighting.RoughnessWeight
description: How much to count a surface's roughness against specularity to determine if it can be used for screen-space lighting (0-1)

name: r.GI.ScreenLighting.SpecularCutoff
description: What specular "score" (0-1) will make a pixel invalid for screen-space lighting

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.BaseRenderHeight
description: Calculate screen probe density based on the given render height to maintain performance at higher screen resolutions

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.ClampSamples
description: Clamp ray results to hide NaNs/negatives

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.DirOcclusion.Mode
description:
Enable directional occlusion on screen space probe irradiance
0: Off
1: Only AO darkening
2: Bent cone windowed irradiance

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.DirOcclusion.MultiBounce
description:
Enable approximate multi bounce occlusion on screen space probe irradiance
0: Off
1: Use per-pixel albedo (cheaper)
2: Use accumulated local albedo (more accurate)

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.FireflyFilter.SHProjection
description:
Enable firefly filtering of screen space probes being projected to SH (without modifying the octmap data)
1: StdDev based filter on fresh probes
2: StdDev based filter on all probes

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.FireflyFilter.TraceResults
description:
Enable firefly filtering of trace results in screen space probes
1: Median filter on fresh probes
2: Median filter on all probes

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.JitterMode
description:
Enable temporal jitter of screen space probes. Set as a combination of bitflags
-1: Enable all jitters
 1: Jitter probe capture positions
 2: Jitter probe capture orientations
 4: Jitter final interpolation positions

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.RayMinDistance
description: Minimum distance for ray queries (to avoid self intersections or hitting floating decals)

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Reprojection
description:
Enable reprojection of screen probe data based on camera motion + motion vectors
0: Off
1: On

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Reprojection.NormalChecks
description: Use normal based checks for probe rejection

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.SamplingMode
description:
Sampling mode when generating rays for screen probes
0: Uniform sampling
1: Importance sample brighter octmap texels
2: Balance between mode 1 and specular BRDF based on surface brightness

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.SpatialFilter
description:
Enable spatial filtering of screen space probes
1: Filter probes that were sampled this frame
2: Filter all probes

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.SpatialFilter.AngleChecks
description:
Check for parallax/angle errors during spatial filtering
0: Off
1: Unclamped angle checks
2: Clamp hit distances to preserve contact shadows

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.StratifiedSamples
description:
Reserve rays for stratified sampling in importance sampling modes to improve probe reprojection and filters.
Defined as the number of uniform rays per 2x2 region.

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Subsample.Count
description: Number of probes to sample in each N x N region each frame

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Subsample.Factor
description: Size of temporal subsampling regions (N tile x N tile squares)

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalFilterSpeed
description:
Speed of screen-space temporal filter with clamped average blend mode
0 = infinite accumulation, 1 = no accumulation (accumulated sample weight is clamped to (1/x - 1))

name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalMode
description:
Blend mode for temporal accumulation of screen space probes
0: Off
1: Clamped exponential average
2: Biased shadow-preserving blend

name: r.GI.ScreenSpaceMode
description:
What technique to use for global illumination in screen space
0 - Disable / Black GI
1 - Brute force
2 - ReSTIR
3 - Screen Probes

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace
description: Whether trace requests will try to use screen traces before handing off to world traces

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.InitialHiZMip
description:
The hierarchical mip that screen rays will begin sampling from.
A lower starting mip lets short rays find hits/misses with fewer steps.
A higher starting mip lets long rays sweep the screen more quickly.

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.MaxHiZSteps
description: The maximum number of steps to take per screen trace ray with hierarchical modes.

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.MaxLinearSteps
description: The maximum number of steps to take per screen trace ray with fixed/per-pixel modes.

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.RayDepthOffset
description: Pull screen rays towards the camera to reduce self intersections. Applied as a fraction of the ray origin's screen depth.

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.RayMinDistance
description: World space minimum distance for screen rays to further reduce self intersections.

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.StepMode
description:
How screen traces step through screen buffers
0 - Per-pixel linear steps
1 - Per-pixel DDA steps
2 - Hierarchical DDA steps

name: r.GI.ScreenTrace.SurfaceThickness
description:
Estimated thickness of gbuffer surfaces as a fraction of their screen depth.
Higher values allow rays passing farther behind surfaces to be treated as hits, with the risk of more false positives.

name: r.GI.Specular
description:
Enable or disable GI system specular
0: Use old specular (i.e. env-probes)
1: Use GI specular (where possible)
2: Use GI specular and disable old specular (for dev purposes)
-1: Disable old specular but don't render new specular (for dev purposes)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies
description: On/off firefly cleanup pass before filtering

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.FullRes.CleanupRadius
description:
Search radius for firefly removal pass, in pixels
(used when not upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.FullRes.HighThreshold
description:
Threshold for bright fireflies to be marked for removal
(used when not upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.FullRes.LowThreshold
description:
Threshold for dark fireflies to be marked for removal
(used when not upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.FullRes.MarkRadius
description:
Search radius for firefly marking pass, in pixels
(used when not upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.HalfRes.CleanupRadius
description:
Search radius for firefly removal pass, in full-res pixels
(used when upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.HalfRes.HighThreshold
description:
Threshold for bright fireflies to be marked for removal
(used when upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.HalfRes.LowThreshold
description:
Threshold for bright fireflies to be marked for removal
(used when upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.CleanupFireflies.HalfRes.MarkRadius
description:
Search radius for firefly marking pass, in full-res pixels
(used when upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise
description:
Denoise mode for specular GI
0 - No Denoise
1 - Split-ratio estimator
2 - A-Trous bilateral filter

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise.Atrous.NumPasses
description: How many passes to use in the A-trous filter (Min 2)

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise.Atrous.StepRadius.FullRes
description: Filter radius in steps, for each full-res pass (final pass is always full-res)

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise.Atrous.StepRadius.HalfRes
description: Filter radius in steps, for each half-res pass

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise.FullRes.FilterRadius
description:
Specular spatial denoise radius in pixels
(used when not upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.Denoise.HalfRes.FilterRadius
description:
Specular spatial denoise radius in full-res pixels
(used when upscaling)

name: r.GI.Specular.HalfRes
description: Render parts of specular GI at half resolution and upscale

name: r.GI.Specular.LowGlossBoundary
description: GBuffer gloss value where we switch to low-gloss GI mode

name: r.GI.Specular.LowGlossFade
description: Fade range around LowGloss boundary

name: r.GI.Specular.MidGlossBoundary
description: GBuffer gloss value where we switch to mid-gloss GI mode

name: r.GI.Specular.MidGlossFade
description: Fade range around MidGloss boundary

name: r.GI.Specular.Temporal
description: Enable temporal filtering of specular GI

name: r.GI.SupportCubemapGBuffer
description:
Allows creation of resources for GI software mode. Needs to be on from game start
0 - Off
1 - On

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid
description: Enable the surface probe grid

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.Cascade0Distance
description: Distance to the edge of the first clip-map cascade, extra cascades will be added in powers of 2 until we cover r.GI.Scene.OuterRadius

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.CellSize
description: Distance between probes in the zone-space probe atlas

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.MaxAge
description: Max age of a probe (in frames)

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.NumProbes
description: Number of probes in the atlas (will round up to nearest square)

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.ProbeResolution
description: Square resolution of one probe in the zone-space probe atlas

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.ReprojSphereScale
description: Multiplier on min ray distance for the parallax reprojection sphere

name: r.GI.SurfaceProbeGrid.UpdatesPerFrame
description: How many zone-space probes to update per frame

name: r.GI.Transparency
description: Enable GI support for transparent objects

name: r.GI.Transparency.DepthResolution
description: Number of depth slices in the GI transparency volume

name: r.GI.Transparency.FarDist
description: Range of the GI transparency volume (in meters)

name: r.GI.Transparency.NearDist
description: Range of the GI transparency volume (in meters)

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.CellSize
description: Distance between probes in the zone-space probe atlas

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.NumCascades
description: How many power-of-two cascades to add finer detail

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.NumDownsamples
description: Pow-2 downsample size from full-res probes to filtered texture

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.ProbeResolution
description: Square resolution of one probe in the zone-space probe atlas

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.UpdatesPerFrame
description: How many zone-space probes to update per frame

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.UseDepthCulling
description: Use depth culling when scheduling transparency probe grid updates

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeGrid.ValidateIndexing
description: Check all probe grid indices/allocations for duplicate/orphaned values

name: r.GI.Transparency.ProbeResolution
description: Square resolution of a GI transparency volume probe (4 or 8)

name: r.GI.Transparency.SpatialFilterSampleWeight
description:
Amount the spatial filter should sample from each neighbor (in each cardinal direction) when blending.
The middle sample will have a weight of 1 - 4*this.
A value of 0 means no spatial filtering.

name: r.GI.Transparency.TemporalFilterSpeed
description: Speed of temporal filter: 0 = infinite accumulation, 1 = no accumulation (accumulated sample weight is clamped to (1/x - 1))

name: r.GI.Transparency.UseDepthCulling
description: Use depth culling for transparency froxel volume

name: r.GI.Transparency.VerticalResolution
description: Number of tiles on the vertical axis in the GI transparency volume (size will be rounded up to the nearest pixel)

name: r.GPUMemory.RecommendedThreshold
description: Amount in MB to deduct from the usable GPU Memory amount to define the recommended threshold (i.e., amount of VRAM targeted by Auto-Detect and used by Options screen). When usage goes over this threshold, warnings are displayed

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI
description:
Display UI bar & text to represent GPU Memory usage & budget.
0 = GPU Memory Bar UI disabled.
1 = GPU Memory Bar UI enabled in graphics settings menu. (Default)
2 = GPU Memory Bar UI enabled everywhere.

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.AnimFrequency
description: GPU Memory usage UI bar's flashing frequency (in seconds).

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.Border
description: GPU Memory usage UI bar's inner border [0,1].

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.Height

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.TitleText.Offset

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.TitleText.Scale

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.TooltipText.Offset

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.TooltipText.Scale

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.Width

name: r.GPUMemoryBarUI.Y

name: r.GPUMemoryTracker.DisplaySystemBudgets

name: r.GPUMemoryTracker.DumpSnapshots
description: Writes GPU memory stats gathered to a CSV file.

name: r.GPUMemoryTracker.Enabled
description: Enable tracking of resources allocating GPU memory.

name: r.GamePostEffectsStage
description:
Toggles game post effect stage
0: Disabled
1: Enabled

name: r.GraphicsPipeline.AllowAsyncMatPermutationCompilation
description:
0: Stall for fallbacks and demanded permutation
1: Stall for demanded permutation
2: (Default) Don't stall

name: r.GraphicsPipeline.AllowAsyncShaderCompilation
description: Allow Async Compilation of Shaders at the cost of wrong looking rendering. The default (0) will instead stall the game still the shader is compiled

name: r.GraphicsPipeline.SkipRedundantDeviceStateChanges

name: r.GraphicsRenderer
description:
Set Graphics API to use for rendering.
0 = Direct3D 11
1 = Vulkan (Default)

name: r.HardwareRayTracing
description:
Enable hardware-accelerated ray tracing if available.
-1 = Auto (Enable if available and devtools present)0  = Disabled
1  = Enabled (if available)

name: r.ImposterStage
description:
Control visibility of Imposters.
 0: Off
 1: On if no composite flare

name: r.ImposterStage.AlwaysOn
description: Always render Distant Imposters (useful for debugging bulb size)

name: r.ImposterStage.AngleFalloff
description: Angle falloff rate for flares at edge of projectors/area lights (0 = instant)

name: r.ImposterStage.FadeInPowCurve
description: Pow Curve applied to fade in of imposters

name: r.ImposterStage.FadeInWidth

name: r.ImposterStage.FadeOutPowcurve
description: Pow Curve applied to fad out of imposters

name: r.ImposterStage.Multiplier
description: Applies a brightness multiplier to Distant Imposters

name: r.ImposterStage.Width
description: Minimum width in pixels of Distant Imposters, at this width they become squares

name: r.LegacyLensOpticsStage
description:
Toggles composited lens flare stage
0: Disabled
1: Enabled

name: r.LegacyOptics.HDR
description: Toggles legacy optics going through the HDR pipeline

name: r.LegacyOptics.HDR.Brightness
description: Brightness adjust applied to non-HDR flares when they're rendered directly to the HDR target

name: r.LegacyOptics.HDR.Gamma
description: Gamma curve applied to non-HDR flares when they're rendered directly to the HDR target

name: r.LightingDebug
description: Draw a grid of spheres in screen-space to preview the lighting.

name: r.LightingDebug.Material
description: Default material to use for r.LightingDebug. Refers to e_DefaultMaterial for description of materials.

name: r.LightingDebug.Scale
description: Spacing of the spheres for r.LightingDebug.

name: r.LinuxWINEOverride
description: Enable override to treat certain Renderer aspects (Display, syncing) as running WINE under Linux on the Vulkan Renderer.

name: r.MeshAggregate.MergeRenderParams
description:
MeshAggregate: Merges StatObj_RenderParams of the bound MeshRenderObject children when possible (Joints).
0: Off
1: On

name: r.MeshAggregate.MergeSubObjects
description:
MeshAggregate: Merges draw calls across SubObjects when possible.
0: Off
1: On

name: r.Ocean.Caustics
description:
Toggles advanced water caustics for oceans and rivers.
Usage: r.Ocean.Caustics [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 - disables.

name: r.Ocean.CausticsIntensity
description:
Water caustics intensity for oceans and rivers.
Usage: r.Ocean.CausticIntensity [f]
Default is 16.0

name: r.PSOCacheGen
description: Enables/Disables the PSOCacheGen (Also stops PSO compilation at runtime if turned off)

name: r.PSOCacheGen.CompileShaders
description: Compiles shaders before PSO creation. If turned off PSO will skipped if not all shaders are compiled.

name: r.PSOCacheGen.DebugConvertBinToText
description: Converts the binary file to a human readable text format. Tries from P4K first, then from USER./n1: Convert all pipelines./n2:Skip invalid and not matching sys-specs.

name: r.PSOCacheGen.DebugConvertTextToBin
description: Converts the text file (e.g. created with r.PSOCacheGen.TextMode) into the binary (.pso) format.

name: r.PSOCacheGen.DebugLog
description: Enables extensive logging for the PSOCacheGen

name: r.PSOCacheGen.DisplayProgress
description: Displays the progress on screen

name: r.PSOCacheGen.LogCacheMisses
description: Logs PSOCache Misses in a file

name: r.PSOCacheGen.Multithreaded
description: If turned on all available background workers are used to process PSOs in parallel.

name: r.PSOCacheGen.RunOnStart
description: Immediately start compiling PSOs as soon as possible when the engine starts
