name: r_DeferredShadingScissor
description:
Toggles deferred shading scissor test.
Usage: r_DeferredShadingScissor [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled)

name: r_DeferredShadingStencilPrepass
description:
Toggles deferred shading stencil pre pass.
Usage: r_DeferredShadingStencilPrepass [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled)

name: r_DeferredShadingTiledCoherencyOpt
description:
Enable optimizations to make tiled light access more coherent
0 - Traditional, high-branching code
1 - Force high-level branches on light type to collapse lower level branches (default)
2 - Try to process lights in homogeneous loops

name: r_DeferredShadingTiledMaxNumLights
description: Clamp maximum input lights to tiled shading. -1 uses engine maximum (currently 1024)

name: r_DeferredShadingTiledVGPRHack
description: Enable a hack to prevent code reordering in tiled shading (Default: true)

name: r_DepthOfField
description:
Enables depth of field.
Usage: r_DepthOfField [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 Enabled, 2 Full-resolution mode

name: r_DepthOfFieldAberration
description: Applies chromatic aberration to out-of-focus areas

name: r_DepthOfFieldCoCResolve
description: Enables temporal blending of circle-of-confusion mask to reduce DOF flickering with TAA

name: r_DepthOfFieldMaxRings
description:
Usage: r_DepthOfFieldMaxRings [n]
Enables experimental descending ring sorting if n > 0, where n is the maximum number of rings allowed (clamped to [3, 8])

name: r_DepthOfFieldSqueezeFactor
description: Simulates Bokeh squeezing occuring with anamorphic lenses

name: r_DepthOfFieldTest
description: Enforce DOF to be active with some default CoC parameters

name: r_DisplacementFactor
description:
Global displacement amount.
Default is 1.0f.

name: r_DisplayForceResize
description: Force a resize of all existing windows.

name: r_DisplayInfo
description:
Toggles debugging information in top-right of screen with information customized via cvar 'sys_devteam'.
Usage: 
 0: off
 1: minimal data related to your team + issues
 2: + extended data related to your team
 3: + basic data not directly related to your team
 4: + extended data not directly related to your team
 5: + further extended data

name: r_DisplaySessionInfo
description:
Toggles session info qr code.
Usage: 
 0: off
 1: on

name: r_DrawNearFarPlane
description: Default is 40.

name: r_DrawNearFoV
description:
Sets the FoV for drawing of near objects.
Usage: r_DrawNearFoV [n]
Default is 60.

name: r_DrawNearZRange
description: Default is 0.1.

name: r_DynTexSourceSharedRTHeight
description: Height override of shared RT for dynamic texture sources. Takes effect when bigger than 0.

name: r_DynTexSourceSharedRTUseMipMapping
description:
Enables mip maps and their generation when rendering dynamic texture sources using the shared RT.
0 - Mip mapping disabled
1 - Mip mapping enabled for selected Flash materials
2 - Mip mapping enabled for all Flash materials

name: r_DynTexSourceSharedRTWidth
description: Width override for shared RT for dynamic texture sources. Takes effect when bigger than 0.

name: r_EnableStableGPUPowerState
description: Enables ID3D12Device::SetStablePowerState. But requieres active window developer mode.

name: r_EnvCMResolution
description:
Sets resolution for target environment cubemap, in pixels.
Usage: r_EnvCMResolution #
where # represents:
	0: 64
	1: 128
	2: 256
Default is 2 (256 by 256 pixels).

name: r_EnvironmentProbeGBufferRes
description: Resolution of environment probe G-Buffers

name: r_EnvironmentProbeQuality
description:
Default quality setting for GPU-compressed environment probes.
0 = Fast
1 = High Quality

name: r_EnvironmentProbeRes
description: Resolution of environment probes (must match rc.ini)

name: r_ExcludeMesh
description:
Exclude or ShowOnly the named mesh from the render list.
Usage: r_ExcludeMesh Name
Usage: r_ExcludeMesh !Name

name: r_ExposureAdaptRangePupil
description: Number of stops the pupil can adjust towards scene luminance from resting state (current pigment adaptation).

name: r_ExposureAdaptTimeBright
description: Seconds taken for photopigments to adapt halfway towards brighter scene luminance.

name: r_ExposureAdaptTimeDark
description: Seconds taken for photopigments to adapt halfway towards darker scene luminance.

name: r_ExposureAdaptTimePupil
description: Seconds taken for pupil and ganglion cells to adapt halfway towards scene luminance.

name: r_ExposureCompensationEV0
description: Exposure compensation to apply at EV 0 (moonlit night).

name: r_ExposureCompensationEV12
description: Exposure compensation to apply at EV 12. (overcast day)

name: r_ExposureCompensationEV16
description: Exposure compensation to apply at EV 16. (sand/snow on sunny day)

name: r_ExposureCompensationEV4
description: Exposure compensation to apply at EV 4 (dark interior).

name: r_ExposureCompensationEV8
description: Exposure compensation to apply at EV 8 (bright interior).

name: r_ExposureDebug
description:
Debug views for exposure and tonemapping.
Usage: 
 0 = Disabled
 1 = Show luminance histogram and exposure values-1 = All debug labels disabled

name: r_ExposureDebugCamera
description: Debug the exposure settings on the camera being sent to the renderer

name: r_ExposureDebugScale
description: Scale of debug histogram for r_ExposureDebug

name: r_ExposureDebugWeights
description: Debug render the weights applied to histogram luminances for perspective correction

name: r_ExposureDiscardRatioBright
description: Fraction of brightest pixels to discard.

name: r_ExposureDiscardRatioDark
description: Fraction of darkest pixels to discard.

name: r_ExposureMultiplierMax
description: Maximum multiplier to use for exposure.

name: r_ExposureMultiplierMin
description: Minimum multiplier to use for exposure.

name: r_ExposureTargetEV
description:
Lock the exposure to the given EV.
Negative values are interpreted as their positive equivalent, with debug text disabled.

name: r_ExposureThresholdRange
description: Dynamic range (from max luminance) to keep after discarding brightest pixels.

name: r_FlareHqShafts
description:
Toggles high quality mode for point light shafts.
Usage: r_FlareHqShafts [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: r_FlaresIrisShaftMaxPolyNum
description:
Set the maximum number of polygon of IrisShaft.
Usage : r_FlaresIrisShaftMaxPolyNum [n]
Default is 200
0 Infinite

name: r_FlaresTessellationRatio
description:
Set the tessellation rate of flares. 1 is the original mesh.
Usage : r_FlaresTessellationRatio 0.5
Default is 1.0
Range is from 0 to 1

name: r_FlashlightBounceEnable
description:
Enable/Disable bounce light.
0 - Disable bounce light
1 - Enable bounce light and make the Flash lights which have the bounce light flag turned on as candidates

name: r_FlashlightBounceMultiplier
description: Multiplier of the final result of the bounce lighting

name: r_FogBlurEnabled
description: Enable blurring due to fog and other volumetrics

name: r_FogDownscaledSunShadow
description:
Enable replacing sun shadow maps with downscaled shadow maps
0: disabled
1: replace first and second cascades with downscaled shadow maps
2: replace first, second, and third cascades with downscaled shadow maps

name: r_FogDownscaledSunShadowRatio
description:
Set downscale ratio for sun shadow maps
0: 1/4 downscaled sun shadow maps
1: 1/8 downscaled sun shadow maps
2: 1/16 downscaled sun shadow maps

name: r_FogGIColorScale
description: Globally scale fog color when GI is active

name: r_FogGIDensityScale
description: Globally scale fog density when GI is active

name: r_FogGasCloudQueryMode
description:
Modes for querying gas cloud data, which is used by fog for blending between the two systems. 
0 - Old behavior where density + colour returned 0 
1 - Single sample of gas cloud at camera location 
2 - New mode where camera aligned grid of points are sampled, for smoother interpolation.

name: r_FogLightingAnisotropy
description: 'K' term for anisotropic scattering function in fog - Range [-1,1], negative numbers = backward-scattering. Default 0.6

name: r_FogLightingExtinction
description: Multiplier on the opacity of fog at a given density (default 0.3)

name: r_FogLightingRadialLobe
description: Radiality of fog scattering (was a param per light)

name: r_FogLightingScatter
description: Multiplier on the brightness of lights in fog (default 1)

name: r_FogLightingShadowExtinction
description: Multiplier on the opacity of fog when calculating self-shadows at a given density (default 1.0)

name: r_FogLightingUVJitter
description: Jitter UVs during inscatter calculation to reduce aliasing on narrow projectors

name: r_FogMinimumLightBulbSize
description: Adjust the minimum size threshold for light attenuation bulb size. Small bulb size causes the light flicker.

name: r_FogRaymarchStartDistance
description: Distance of first fog raymarch step

name: r_FogReprojectZoneMovement
description: Enable reprojection based on movement of fog volumes due to their parent zone's movement.

name: r_FogReprojectionBlendFactor
description:
Adjust the blend factor of temporal reprojection.
Acceptable value is between 0 and 1.
0 means temporal reprojecton is off.

name: r_FogReprojectionMode
description:
Set the mode of ghost reduction for temporal reprojection.
0: conservative
1: advanced

name: r_FogShadowQuality
description:
Adjust shadow sample count per sample point.
0: 1 shadow sample per sample point
1: 2 shadow samples per sample point
2: 3 shadow samples per sample point
3: 4 shadow samples per sample point

name: r_FogTracingQuality
description:
Adjust number of sample points.
0: 1 sample point in a voxel
1: 2 sample points in a voxel
2: 4 sample points in a voxel

name: r_FogTracingTexDepth
description:
Depth resolution of volume texture.
Huge value runs out of performance and video memory.

name: r_FogTracingTexHeight
description:
Width and height scale factor (divided by screen resolution) for volume texture.
Acceptable value is more than equal 2.

name: r_FogVisAreaEpsilon
description: Slightly increases visarea sizes to cover tiny gaps between areas

name: r_FogVoxelisationDistance
description: World-space size of fog's froxel volume

name: r_ForceResetTemporalEffects
description: Force temporal effects to the state they'd be in just after a camera cut

name: r_FourierShadowsPoolSize
description: Set size of fourier (gascloud) shadow pool

name: r_GPUBufferUpdateValidation
description:
Enable/Disable validation of GPU buffer update.
0 = GPU Buffer Update Validation Disabled
1 = GPU Buffer Update Validation Enabled

name: r_GPUCrash_Force
description: Force a GPU Crash in TiledShading

name: r_GPUMarkers
description:
Insert markers into the GPU timeline to track GPU crashes.
0 - Disabled
1 - Track pipeline stage (regular).
2 - Track pipeline stage (verbose).
3 - Track draws/compute commands.

name: r_GPUMemDemotionLogFreq
description: The frequency of reporting GPU memory demotion log in seconds.

name: r_Gamma
description:
Adjusts the graphics card gamma correction (fast, needs hardware support, affects also HUD and desktop)
Usage: r_Gamma 1.0
1 off (default), accepted range on PS3 is 0.8 to 1.25

name: r_GasCloudAllowEditorMode
description: Allow the gas cloud to display edit-friendly changes (eg. culling solid areas when the camera is inside them)

name: r_GasCloudAsyncRenderNodeZoneInsertion
description: Enables/disables async render node zone insertion

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierAbsorbanceOffset
description: Offset input depth when reconstructing optical depth from fourier data. Visual control for camera fourier AO map.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierAbsorbanceReductionMult
description: Multiplier for when reconstructing transmittance from fourier weights. Reduces magnitude of high frequency details. Visual control for camera fourier AO map.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierAbsorbanceScale
description: Scales input depth when reconstructing optical depth from fourier data. Visual control for camera fourier AO map.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierEnable
description: Apply fourier shadow map from camera's location, like an AO map.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierGradient
description: Camera fourier AO map power curve gradient.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierMaxSizeOuter
description: Gas cloud camera fourier max outer size radius, for where tracing ends.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierMinSizeInner
description: Gas cloud camera fourier min inner size radius, for where tracing starts.

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierPreProcessTargetOpacity
description: Opacity to reach when tracing chunks in camera fourier pre process pass, this decides when to stop tracing and outputs trace depth distance

name: r_GasCloudCameraFourierPreProcesssEnable
description: Enable pre process pass for camera fourier shadows, which traces main view visible chunks for determining what distance the opacity reaches it's target and therefore no further chunks tracing is needed.

name: r_GasCloudDebug
description:
Gas cloud debug modes:
0: Disabled (default)
1: Solid walls
2: Show chunk boundaries
3: Low-alpha rays - boost very low alpha rays to visible opacity

name: r_GasCloudDebugCPUDensity
description: Draw a scanning slice of density values calculated using only CPU data and world-space sample points

name: r_GasCloudDebugCPUDensityScale
description: Density->Debug Opacity scale when visualising CPU density samples

name: r_GasCloudDebugCutoff
description: Value for r_GasCloudDebug 1, anything greater than this value will appear solid

name: r_GasCloudDebugDrawChunkIdx
description: Draw the chunk index at the center of the chunk in world space

name: r_GasCloudDebugDumpChunkVoxels
description: Dump all the voxel values for the specified chunk index to .csv file

name: r_GasCloudDebugEmptyVoxelThreshold
description: Voxel data must be less than or equal to this threshold value in order to be considered empty in the debug selection mode.

name: r_GasCloudDebugLinks
description: Draw links between child and parent clouds

name: r_GasCloudDebugMaxChunks
description: Cap number of drawn GasCloud chunks

name: r_GasCloudDebugMinMipHeight
description: Cap detail level - zero is maximum detail

name: r_GasCloudDebugSelection
description: Displays debug information for the current selected gas cloud. (Editor only)

name: r_GasCloudDebugShowChunks
description: Display chunk AABBs as debug geometry

name: r_GasCloudDebugSlice
description:
Debug mode that renders a slice through the gas cloud to visualize various information:
0: Disabled (default)
1: Regular shading
2: Density
3: Chunk resolution

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceAxisGS
description: Determines which axis to render the plane slice in group space 0 = X, 1 = Y, 2 = Z

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceDensityMultiplier
description: Modify density when rendering debug slice

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceHeatMapRangeModifier
description: Used to shift the range of the heat map ratio

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceHeatMapSteps
description: Number of different colours we can have to represent the different sizes of chunks

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceLightIntensityMultiplier
description: Modify light intensity when rendering debug slice

name: r_GasCloudDebugSliceRatioOS
description: Ratio across gascloud BBox in object space. Determines where to render plane slice.

name: r_GasCloudDebugSunShadowVolumes
description: Draw bounds of gascloud sun shadow stencil volumes

name: r_GasCloudEnabled
description: Enable gas cloud tech. Default: 1

name: r_GasCloudForceDensityDataType
description:
Determines what data type to treat the gas cloud density resource as. (Does not change the data type, just informs the engine what data type is expected for optimizations.)
0: Automatic detection based on compiled VDB.
1: Float32.
2: Float16.
3: Uint8.

name: r_GasCloudForceSunShadowDataType
description:
Force specific data type to be used for storing sun shadows tree. 
0: Float32.
1: Uint8.

name: r_GasCloudGenerateSunShadows
description: Generate WIP sun shadows on new gasclouds

name: r_GasCloudInscatterBrickMaxSize
description: Maximum resolution of a block in the inscatter pool. Default 32

name: r_GasCloudInscatterBrickMinSize
description: Minimum resolution of a block in the inscatter pool. Default 8

name: r_GasCloudInscatterMaxBrightness
description: Max brightness stored in gas cloud accumulator textures

name: r_GasCloudInscatterPoolSize
description: Resolution of the inscatter pool (rounds up to power of 2)

name: r_GasCloudInscatterResRatio
description: Relative resolution of light accumulator leaf voxel size

name: r_GasCloudNumBucketIndices
description: Max number of bucket indices used for pre-binning gascloud nodes

name: r_GasCloudNumBucketsX
description: Number of buckets used for pre-binning gascloud nodes (X axis)

name: r_GasCloudNumBucketsY
description: Number of buckets used for pre-binning gascloud nodes (Y axis)

name: r_GasCloudOverrideColorsWithVolume
description: Override gas clouds' albedo and light leak when inside of override volumes

name: r_GasCloudOverrideDensityWithVolume
description: Override gas clouds' density scale when inside of override volumes

name: r_GasCloudSkipHiddenChildNodesInSubdivision
description: Skip subdivision of cloud if the child clouds are hidden

name: r_GasCloudStats
description:
Display gas cloud debug stats. Default: 0 
1 - High level stats 
2 - Octree tree allocation debug 
3 - Individual light stats

name: r_GasCloudStepLengthMultiplier
description: Fixed multiplier on gascloud step length

name: r_GasCloudStreamInScreenSizeRatio
description: Ratio of screen size that has to change from the stream out size, in order for the gas cloud to be requested to load. Ensures we do not constantly ping pong between loading/unloading gas clouds

name: r_GasCloudStreamOutScreenSizeThreshold
description: Screen size threshold for determining when to allow streaming out of gas clouds. This is in addition of zone system screen space size culling, which won't update streaming state if below culling threshold.

name: r_GasCloudStreamingDebug
description:
Show gascloud streaming info
1: Show color-coded bounding boxes
2: Show text list of streaming resources

name: r_GasCloudSunShadowResolutionMult
description: Multiplier for adjusting computed sun shadows resolution

name: r_GasCloudSunShadowSupersample
description: Log2 resolution multiplier for sun shadow generation

name: r_GasCloudTemporalInscatterRelativeDifferenceBiasFar
description: Controls when temporal history should be discard based on how much inscatter changed

name: r_GasCloudTemporalInscatterRelativeDifferenceBiasNear
description: Controls when temporal history should be discard based on how much inscatter changed

name: r_GasCloudTemporalInscatterRelativeDifferenceScale
description: Controls when temporal history should be discard based on how much inscatter changed

name: r_GasCloudTemporalUpsample
description: Use Temporal Upsampling on Gas Clouds

name: r_GasCloudUpsample
description: Screen res downscale step for gascloud rendering

name: r_GasCloudVoxelTargetScreenSpaceSize
description: How much vertical resolution a single voxel should occupy before trying to split to sub-nodes

name: r_GeomCacheInstanceThreshold
description: Threshold after which instancing is used to draw geometry cache pieces

name: r_GetScreenShot
description:
Capture a single screenshot (variable is set to 0 after capturing)
1: Take screenshot immediately
2: Take screenshot 10 frames after resetting temporal effects

name: r_GfxReconstructCapture
description: Trigger GfxReconstruct capture.

name: r_GfxReconstructDebug
description:
0 = GfxReconstruct will optimize captures and delete intermediary data
1 = GfxReconstruct will leave all intermediary data

name: r_GfxReconstructEnabled
description:
Enable GfxReconstruct captures via cvar. Needs to be set before loading the Client/Editor and impacts performance.
0 = Disabled
1 = Enabled

name: r_GfxReconstructFKey
description: Function Key that triggers capture. Default is 0 (Disabled). Needs to be set before loading the Client/Editor.

name: r_GfxReconstructFlush
description:
0 = GfxReconstruct will batch commands together for capturing (Default)
1 = GfxReconstruct will flush after each write to file.

name: r_GfxReconstructFrameCount
description: Sets the number of frames GfxReconstruct will capture. Default 10. Needs to be set before loading the Client/Editor.

name: r_GpuMemoryUsageUpdateFreq
description: The update frequency of gpu memory usage in display info.

name: r_HDRDebug
description:
Toggles HDR debug visualization
0: off (default)
1: colormap of displayed output luminance in nits (cyan: 100 nits, yellow: 1.000 nits, magenta: 10.000 nits)
2: identify illegal colors (grey: normal, red: NotANumber, green: negative)
3: colormap of absolute luminance values

name: r_HDRDisplayDeviceLimits
description: Restricts HDR output to the maximum brightness reported for the current display.

name: r_HDRDisplayMaxNits
description: Restricts HDR output to specified maximum brightness.

name: r_HDRDisplayOutput
description:
Toggles HDR output for an HDR-capable display.
0: off
1: on (if app window is on HDR display)

name: r_HDRDisplayRefWhite
description:
Adjusts the reference white point (aka paper white or UI white) for brighter-than-standard viewing conditions.
Minimum is 80 nits, default 200 nits

name: r_HDRDitherGrainSize
description:
Override the pixel size of combined dither grain.
-1: Use camera setting

name: r_HDRDitherGrainSize_default
description: The pixel size of combined dither grain. Default is 1.5

name: r_HDRDitherGrainStrength
description:
Override the strength of combined film grain and dithering, applied during tone mapping.
-1: Use camera setting
 0: Disable

name: r_HDRDitherGrainStrength_default
description: The strength of combined film grain and dithering, applied during tone mapping. Default is 3.0

name: r_HDRDitherMode
description: Selects dither mode (0: legacy, 1: combined dither and film grain)

name: r_HDRGradingCapture
description:
Captures an exposure-corrected HDR screenshot with embedded color chart (for color grading).
1: Standard linear profile
2: Punchy profile with increased contrast

name: r_HDRGrainAmount
description:
Override the scaling factor on legacy film-grain, which itself is dependent on the current exposure. 
 -1: Use camera setting

name: r_HDRTexFormat
description:
HDR texture format. 
Usage: r_HDRTexFormat [Value] 0:(low precision - cheaper/faster), 1:(high precision)
Default is 0

name: r_HDRTonemappingCurve
description:
Toggles tone mapping curve.
0: Linear with clipping (tone mapping off)
1: Hue preserving display mapping
2: ACES filmic curve
3: Legacy hue preserving curve

name: r_HDRTonemappingCurveInputScaleACES
description: Multiplier for input color when using ACES tone mapping curve (1: original)

name: r_HDRTonemappingCurveSlopeACES
description: Adjusts contrast of ACES tone mapping curve (1: original, >1: less crushed blacks)

name: r_HDRVignetting
description:
Override whether vignetting is applied
-1 Use camera setting
0  Force disable
1  Force enable

name: r_HDRVignetting_default
description: Enable/disable vignetting. Default is 1 (enabled)

name: r_Height
description:
Sets the display height in pixels.
Usage: r_Height [600/768/..]

name: r_HideDebugText
description: Hides all debug text.

name: r_HideSunInCubemaps
description: Stops the sun being drawn during cubemap generation.

name: r_IHV_Libraries_Enabled
description:
Enables the Independent Hardware Vendors libraries to be loaded at game start.
0 - Disabled
1 - Enabled

name: r_LargeBatchDisableTessellation
description: Disables tessellation for large batch objects

name: r_LayerBlendMaxTextures
description: The maximum number of textures that can fit in the low res texture library for LayerBlend.

name: r_LayerBlendReload
description:
Reloads textures and materials used by the multilayer material system.
Usage: r_LayerBlendReload 1
Set to 1 to reload textures and materials.

name: r_LayerBlendResolution
description: The resolution of textures that can fit in the low res texture library for LayerBlend.

name: r_LayerBlendSpecTint
description: Enables tinting of metals using the per-layer tints (metal is identified by spec colour > 115).

name: r_LightDebugActive
description: Global toggle for other LightDebug CVars

name: r_LightDebugCullingList
description:
Controls what lights to process in debug mode.
0 - All lights
1 - Lights not hidden by opaque geometry (default)
2 - Lights intersecting opaque geometry

name: r_LightDebugMode
description:
Controls what to draw in debug mode.
0 - Normal scene (default)
1 - Highlight tiles that are performing an extra pass for planar lights
2 - Per-tile overdraw
3 - Experimental planar light modes controlled by r_LightExperimentalPlanarXXX
4 = Show environment probe coverage

name: r_LightDebugOverdrawRange
description: Number of lights that will appear as "hottest" on the overdraw heat map

name: r_LightDebugShowAmbient
description:
Control visibility of ambient lights.
-1 - Show both ambient and non-ambient lights (default)
 0 - Hide ambient lights
 1 - Show only ambient lights

name: r_LightDebugShowEnvProbe
description: Toggle visibility of environment probes

name: r_LightDebugShowGasCloud
description: Toggle visibility of GasCloud lights

name: r_LightDebugShowPlanar
description: Toggle visibility of point lights

name: r_LightDebugShowPoint
description: Toggle visibility of point lights

name: r_LightDebugShowProjector
description:
Control visibility of projectors.
-1 - Show both projectors and non-projectors (default)
 0 - Hide projectors
 1 - Show only projectors

name: r_LightDebugShowShadowCaster
description:
Control visibility of shadow casters.
-1 - Show both casters and non-casters (default)
 0 - Hide shadow casters
 1 - Show only shadow casters
 2 - Skip non-casters that affect the DOF focal plane (and log skipped lights periodically)

name: r_LightExperimentalPlanarDiffuse
description:
(Experimental) Type of area light calculation.
0 - None
1 - Standard CryEngine
2 - Standard CryEngine w/ tweaks
3 - 5-point structured sampling (default)
4 - Form-factor integration
5 - Visualize fallback distance

name: r_LightExperimentalPlanarSpecular
description:
0 - Disable specular
1 - Standard CryEngine (default)
2 - Phong Approximate Mode
3 - Brute force reference

name: r_MergeGeneralDrawcalls
description:
Enabled merging of RenderChunks in General pass
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_MergePreZDrawcalls
description:
Enabled Merging of RenderChunks for PreZRendering
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_MergeShadowDrawcalls
description:
Enabled Merging of RenderChunks for ShadowRendering
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_MotionBlur
description: Enables per object and camera motion blur.

name: r_MotionBlurCameraMotionScale
description: Reduces motion blur for camera movements to account for a fixed focus point of the viewer.

name: r_MotionBlurCinematicMode
description:
Set motion blur behavior during cinematics.
0 - Apply full camera motion
1 - Use gameplay settings for camera motion

name: r_MotionBlurGameplayMode
description:
Set motion blur behavior during gameplay.
0 - Disabled
1 - Exclude camera rotation
2 - Exclude all camera motion

name: r_MotionBlurQuality
description:
Set motion blur sample count.
Usage: r_MotionBlurQuality [0/1/2]
0 - low quality, 1 - medium quality, 2 - high quality

name: r_MotionBlurShutterSpeed
description:
Override the camera exposure time for motion blur (as 1/x seconds).
 -1: Use camera setting

name: r_MotionBlurShutterSpeed_default
description: The camera exposure time for motion blur (as 1/x seconds). Default is 250.0 (1/125 of a second)

name: r_MotionBlurTest
description: Enforce active camera motion vectors on static geometry

name: r_MotionBlurTileCount
description: The tile count for motion blur (which determines the max blur radius).

name: r_MotionVectors
description: Enables generation of motion vectors for dynamic objects

name: r_OpticsBloom
description:
0 = No bloom
1 = CryTek bloom
2 = CIG bloom

name: r_OpticsBloomStrength
description: Multiplier on the final renderer bloom value

name: r_OpticsDownsampleFilter
description:
Downsample filter for optics mip chain
-1 = Auto
0 = Four tap
1 = Nine Tap

name: r_OpticsExposure
description:
0 = Instant eye adaptation
1 = CIG eye adaptation
2 = CIG eye adaptation with dynamic range thresholding

name: r_OpticsFireflyFilter
description:
Anti-firefly filter
-1 = Auto
0 = Four tap
1 = Five Tap
2 = Nine Tap

name: r_OpticsFireflyFilterEnabled
description: Enables/disables the firefly filter on bloom/flares.

name: r_OpticsFlares
description:
0 = No flares
1 = CryTek flares only
2 = CIG flares only
3 = All flares

description:
ShadowMap Sun Const Bias.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunConstDevice value passed to D3D to account for floating point precision issues.

name: r_ShadowBiasSunConstJitterMultiplier
description:
ShadowMap Sun Const Bias Jitter Multiplier.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunConstJitterMultiplier is a multiplier on amount of additional const bias applied based on jitter kernel size

name: r_ShadowBiasSunConstLinearMultiplier
description:
ShadowMap Sun Const Bias Multiplier.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunConstLinearMultiplier is a multiplier on amount of const bias applied during sun shadows mask gen

name: r_ShadowBiasSunConstMaxAngle
description:
ShadowMap Sun Const Max Angle.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunConstMaxAngle is the maximum supported angle that polys in the same texel can be relative to each other and not get bias issues.

name: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeJitterMultiplier
description:
ShadowMap Sun Slope Bias Jitter Multiplier.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeJitterMultiplier is a multiplier on amount of additional slope bias applied based on jitter kernel size

name: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeMaxAngle
description:
ShadowMap Sun Slope Max Angle.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeMaxAngle is the maximum supported angle that geometry can be relative to the sun and not get bias issues.

name: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeMultiplier
description:
ShadowMap Sun Slope Bias Multiplier.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunSlopeMultiplier is a multiplier on amount of slope bias applied at the D3D level during shadow map rendering

name: r_ShadowBiasSunStaticRegionConstLinearOffset
description:
ShadowMap Sun StaticRegion Const Bias Multiplier.
Usage: r_ShadowBiasSunStaticRegionConstLinearOffset is an additional offset on the amount of const bias applied during sun shadows mask gen. Specifically just for static regions

name: r_ShadowGen
description: 0=disable shadow map updates, 1=enable shadow map updates

name: r_ShadowGenDepthClip
description: 0=disable shadow gen depth clipping, 1=enable shadow gen depth clipping

name: r_ShadowJitteringDirectionalLight
description:
Shadow map jittering radius for directional lights.
Usage: r_ShadowJitteringDirectionalLight [0=off]

name: r_ShadowJitteringOmniDirectionalLight
description:
Shadow map jittering radius for omnidirectional light.
Usage: r_ShadowJitteringOmniDirectionalLight [0=off]

name: r_ShadowJitteringProjectionLight
description:
Shadow map jittering radius for projection light.
Usage: r_ShadowJitteringProjectionLight [0=off]

name: r_ShadowMaskRegularLights
description: Toggle rendering of shadow mask for regular lights

name: r_ShadowMaskSun
description: Toggle rendering of shadow mask for Sun light

name: r_ShadowPass
description: Process shadow pass

name: r_ShadowPoolDebugRender
description: Draw shadow pool on screen

name: r_ShadowPoolDebugRenderSize
description: How big to draw shadow pool debug (as fraction of vertical screen resolution)

name: r_ShadowSunCascadeBlendsWithStaticRegion
description: Determine which starting cascade and up is the static region allowed to blend over with max blending. (Index into array value).

name: r_ShadowSunCascadeCopy
description: Enable or disable the process of copying lower sun cascade into higher cascade shadow pool

name: r_ShadowsAdaptionMin
description:
starting kernel size, to avoid blocky shadows.
Usage: r_ShadowsAdaptionMin [0.0 for blocky - 1.0 for blurry], 0.35 is default

name: r_ShadowsAdaptionRangeClamp
description:
maximum range between caster and receiver to take into account.
Usage: r_ShadowsAdaptionRangeClamp [0.0 - 1.0], default 0.01

name: r_ShadowsAdaptionSize
description:
Select shadow map blurriness if r_ShadowJittering is activated.
Usage: r_ShadowsAdaptoinSize [0 for none - 10 for rapidly changing]

name: r_ShadowsGridAligned
description:
Selects algorithm to use for shadow mask generation:
0 - Disable shadows snapping
1 - Enable shadows snapping in world space
2 - Enable shadows snapping relative to zone movement between frames. Zone chosen is the one that encompasses the biggest cascade.

name: r_ShadowsMaskDownScale
description:
Saves video memory by using lower resolution for shadow masks except first one
0=per pixel shadow mask
1=half resolution shadow mask
Usage: r_ShadowsMaskDownScale [0/1]

name: r_ShadowsMaskLocalLights
description:
Add local lights into the screenspace shadow mask as an optimisation (Default = 1)
0=lights sample shadows during lighting pass
1=lights are added to the shadow mask
Usage: r_ShadowsMaskLocalLights [0/1]

name: r_ShadowsNearestMapResolution
description: Nearest shadow map resolution. Default: 4096

name: r_ShadowsPOMSelfShadowEnabled
description: Enable or Disable POM Self Shadow Copy into ShadowMask. Default: 1 = ON

name: r_ShadowsPoolSize
description: Set size of shadow pool (e_ShadowsPoolSize*e_ShadowsPoolSize)

name: r_Sharpening
description:
Image sharpening amount
Usage: r_Sharpening [Value]

name: r_ShowLightBounds
description:
Display light bounds - for debug purpose
Usage: r_ShowLightBounds [0=off/1=on]

name: r_ShowLines
description:
Toggles visibility of wireframe overlay.
Usage: r_ShowLines [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_ShowTexture
description: Displays loaded texture - for debug purpose

name: r_SilhouettePOM
description:
Enables use of silhouette parallax occlusion mapping.
Usage: r_SilhouettePOM [0/1]

name: r_Snow
description:
Enables snow rendering
Usage: r_Snow [0/1/2]
0 - disabled
1 - enabled
2 - enabled with snow occlusion

name: r_SnowDisplacement
description:
Enables displacement for snow accumulation
Usage: r_SnowDisplacement [0/1]
0 - disabled
1 - enabled

name: r_SnowFlakeClusters
description:
Number of snow flake clusters.
Usage: r_SnowFlakeClusters [n]

name: r_SnowHalfRes
description:
When enabled, snow renders at half resolution to conserve fill rate.
Usage: r_SnowHalfRes [0/1]
0 - disabled
1 - enabled

name: r_SonarVision
description:
Toggles sonar vision enabling.
Usage: r_SonarVision [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 2 to enable debug mode (force enabling). Set to 0 to completely disable sonar vision modes.

name: r_Stats
description:
Toggles render statistics.
0=disabled,
1=global render stats,
3=CPU times of render passes and video memory usage,
4=CPU times of render passes,
5=Occlusion query calls (calls to mfDraw/mfReadResult_Now),
6=display per-instance drawcall count,
8=Info about instanced DIPs,
13=print info about cleared RT's,
Usage: r_Stats [0/1/n]

name: r_SupersamplingFilter
description:
Filter method to use when resolving supersampled output
0 - Box filter
1 - Tent filter
2 - Gaussian filter
3 - Lanczos filter

name: r_TessellationTriangleSize
description:
Desired triangle size for screen-space tessellation.
Default is 10.

name: r_TexAnisotropy
description: Specifies the level for anisotropic texture filtering.

name: r_TexBindMode
description:
Enable texture overrides.
Usage: r_TexBindMode [0/1/2/4/5/6/7/8/9/10/11]
	1 - Force grey diffuse maps (other than fonts)
	2 - Force white diffuse maps (other than fonts)
	3 - Force flat normal maps
	4 - Force white gloss maps
	5 - Force white specular maps 
	6 - Force grey height maps
	7 - Force white diffuse maps and flat normal maps
	8 - Force diffuse maps to use mipmapdebug texture
	9 - Colour code diffuse maps to show minimum uploaded mip [0:green,1:cyan,2:blue,3:purple,4:magenta,5:yellow,6:orange,7:red,higher:white]
	10 - Colour code diffuse maps to show textures streaming in in green and out in red
	11 - Colour code diffuse maps that have requested a lower mip than the lowest available [-3: red, -2: yellow, -1: green]
	12 - Visualize textures that have more or less mips in memory than needed
Default is 0 (disabled).

name: r_TexLog
description:
Configures texture information logging.
Usage:	r_TexLog #
where # represents:
	0: Texture logging off
	1: Texture information logged to screen
	2: All loaded textures logged to 'UsedTextures.txt'
	3: Missing textures logged to 'MissingTextures.txt

name: r_TexNoLoad
description:
Disables loading of textures.
Usage:	r_TexNoLoad [0/1]
When 1 texture loading is disabled.

name: r_TexelsPerMeter
description:
Enables visualization of the color coded "texels per meter" ratio for objects in view.
The checkerboard pattern displayed represents the mapping of the assigned diffuse
texture onto the object's uv space. One block in the pattern represents 16x16 texels.
Usage: r_TexelsPerMeter [n] (where n is the desired number of texels per meter; 0 = off)

name: r_TexelsPerMeterUseTiling
description:
0: TexelsPerMeter is from mesh unmodified
1: TexelsPerMeter is relative to layer (HardSurface only atm)

name: r_TextureLodDistanceRatio
description:
Controls dynamic LOD system for textures used in materials.
Usage: r_TextureLodDistanceRatio [-1, 0 and bigger]
Default is -1 (completely off). Value 0 will set full LOD to all textures used in frame.
Values bigger than 0 will activate texture LOD selection depending on distance to the objects.

name: r_TexturesStreaming
description:
Enables direct streaming of textures from disk during game.
Usage: r_TexturesStreaming [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off). All textures save in native format with mips in a
cache file. Textures are then loaded into texture memory from the cache.

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebug
description:
Enables textures streaming debug mode. (Log uploads and remove unnecessary mip levels)
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingDebug [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off).1 - texture streaming log.2 - Show textures hit-parade based on streaming priorities3 - Show textures hit-parade based on the memory consumed

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugDumpIntoLog
description: Dump content of current texture streaming debug screen into log

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugFilter
description: Filters displayed textures by name in texture streaming debug mode

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugLogCleanup
description:
Enables debug log output during cleanup of textures streaming system.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingDebug [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugMinMip
description: Filters displayed textures by loaded mip in texture streaming debug mode

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugMinSize
description: Filters displayed textures by size in texture streaming debug mode

name: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedJobs
description:
Maximum number of tasks submitted to streaming system.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedJobs [jobs number]
Default is 32 jobs

name: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedMB
description:
Maximum amount of texture data requested from streaming system in MB.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedMB [size]
Default is 4.0(MB)

name: r_TexturesStreamingMipBias
description:
Controls how texture LOD depends from distance to the objects.
Increasing this value will reduce amount of memory required for textures.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMipBias [-4..0..4]
Default is 0.

name: r_TexturesStreamingNegativeMipCompRange
description:
Controls how much to compress negative mip-factors to allow resolution reduction on nearby textures.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingNegativeMipCompRange [0.01/1.00]
Default is 0.1

name: r_TexturesStreamingNoUpload
description:
Disable uploading data into texture from system memory. Useful for debug purposes.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingNoUpload [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_TexturesStreamingOnlyVideo
description:
Don't store system memory copy of texture. Applicable only for PC and PS3.
On Xenon it's on[1] by default and cannot be changed.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingOnlyVideo [0/1]
Default is 0 (off) for PC and PS3, 1(on always) for XBox 360.

name: r_TexturesStreamingPoolSize
description: Amount of memory (MB) given to texture streaming system

name: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeMips
description:
Postpone loading of high res mipmaps to improve resolution balance of texture streaming.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeMips [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeThresholdKB
description:
Threshold used to postpone high resolution mipmap loads in KB.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeThresholdKB [size]
Default is 1024(KB)

name: r_TexturesStreamingPrecacheRounds
description:
Number of precache rounds to include in active streamed texture lists.
Default is 1

name: r_TexturesStreamingStreamer
description:
Change which streaming implementation is used for streaming textures.
Default is 1.
0: Planning Texture Streamer
1: Balanced Texture Streamer

name: r_TexturesStreamingSuppress
description:
Force unloading of all textures and suppress new stream tasks.
Default is 0

name: r_TexturesStreamingTopMipOnlyBias
description:
The mip bias for top mip only streaming textures, ex: runtime cubemap.
Reducing this value can prevent top mip only textures from being streamed out as regular textures.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingTopMipOnlyBias [-4..0..4]
Default is -1.0.

name: r_ThermalVision
description:
Toggles thermal vision enabling.
Usage: r_ThermalVision [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 2 to enable debug mode (force enabling). Set to 0 to completely disable thermal vision modes.

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMaxIntensity
description:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker random max intensity.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMaxIntensity [0.0+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the min scaling factor at which the object displays hot in thermal vision

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMinIntensity
description:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker random min intensity.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMinIntensity [0.0+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the min scaling factor at which the object displays hot in thermal vision

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencyPrimary
description:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker primary frequency.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencyPrimary [1+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the inverse frequency of the primary sine wave for the objects heat. Higher = slower

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencySecondary
description:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker secondary frequency.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencySecondary [1+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the inverse frequency of the secondary sine wave for the objects heat. Higher = slower

name: r_TranspAfterDOFDepthBias
description: Depth bias applied to TRANSP_AFTER_MB_DOF render list to prevent z-fighting when TSAA matrix jittering is active

name: r_TranspAfterDOFForceDistUI
description: Distance within which interactive display screens are forced to TRANSP_AFTER_MB_DOF render list

name: r_TranspDepthFixup
description:
Write approximate depth for certain transparent objects before post effects
Usage: r_TranspDepthFixup [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled)

name: r_UIBaseChromaAmount
description:
The baseline amount of chromatic aberration on holograms and Scaleform.
Default is 0.0f, 0 = no chroma aberration, higher = stronger chroma aberration

name: r_UIBlendMode
description:
Adjusts how the UI is blended onto the scene.
0 Alpha blend, 1 Additive, 2 Screen, 3 Custom CIG (additive + alpha blend), 4 Color dodge

name: r_UILuminanceThreshold
description:
The luminance value below which alpha blending kicks in with the custom CIG blending mode.
Default is 0.5f

name: r_UIShadowAmount
description:
Increases the visibility of holograms and Scaleform against bright backgrounds with a drop shadow.
Default is 0.0f, 0 = no drop shadow, higher = more visible shadow

name: r_UV_DebugGun
description:
Debug Gun to render text displaying the UV coords of the specific point of an object. (Centre of the screen ray down Z axis).
0 - Disabled
1 - Enabled

name: r_UltraResScreenshot
description:
Captures a series of NxN images that can be stitched together to get an ultra-resolution image
Usage: r_UltraResScreenshot 2/3/4/../N

name: r_UltraResScreenshotStabilization
description: Number of times we should repeat rendering of a frame before capturing as part of r_UltraResScreenshot, for the benefit of any temporal techniques

name: r_Unlit
description: Render just diffuse texture with no lighting (for most materials).

name: r_UseGPUPriority
description: Enable to bump the GPU priority of the process to highest. Useful for profiling out of focus windows. But can badly affect running two GPU intensive applications at once

name: r_UseTerrainTextures2K
description: Use 2K resolution terrain textures.

name: r_UserChromaticAberration
description:
User options chromatic aberration amount (0-1)
Usage: r_UserChromaticAberration [Value]

name: r_UserSharpening
description:
User image sharpening amount (0-1)
Usage: r_UserSharpening [Value]

name: r_VSync
description:
Toggles vertical sync.
Usage: r_VSync [0/1]
0: Disabled
1: Enabled

name: r_VignetteBlur
description: Set strength of the vignette blur which is active during gameplay (0 to disable it)

name: r_VignetteBlurEditor
description: Allow vignette blur in Editor editing mode

name: r_VisAreaClipLightsPerPixel
description: Per pixel light/cubemap culling for vis areas: 0=off, 1=on

name: r_WaterGodRays
description:
Enables under water god rays.
Usage: r_WaterGodRays [0/1/2]
Default is 1 (Wobble, no god rays). Disable with 0, enable godrays and wobble with 2

name: r_WaterGodRaysDistortion
description:
Set the amount of distortion when underwater.
Usage: r_WaterGodRaysDistortion [n]
Default is 1.

name: r_Width
description:
Sets the display width in pixels.
Usage: r_Width [800/1024/..]

name: r_WindowMode
description:
Sets the window mode for the application.
Usage: r_WindowMode [0=windowed/1=borderless/2=fullscreen]

name: r_WindowMode_FlipDisabled
description: Disables the flip present mode in Windows (currently causing visual issues on some hardware).

name: r_ZFightingDepthScale
description: Controls anti z-fighting measures in shaders (scaling homogeneous z).

name: r_ZFightingExtrude
description: Controls anti z-fighting measures in shaders (extrusion along normal in world units).

name: r_ZFightingShadowDepthScale
description: Controls anti z-fighting measures in the shadow pass (scaling homogeneous z).

name: r_ZPassDepthSorting
description:
Toggles Z pass depth sorting.
Usage: r_ZPassDepthSorting [0/1/2]
0: No depth sorting
1: Sort by depth layers (default)
2: Sort by distance

name: r_ZPrePassSkipObjectsInMotion
description: Toggles skipping z pre pass for chunks that will render motion vectors

name: r_ZPrePassVertDensityThreshold
description:
Threshold value to allow objects to render into z pre pass. Measured as chunk surface area per vert.
Usage: r_ZPrePassVertDensityThreshold [value]

name: r_ZReadbackNaNCheck
description:
Check for NaNs in downsampled ZTarget
Usage: 
0 disabled
1 Fix NaNs in depth buffer during ZReadback
2 Assert on NaNs in depth buffer and fix them during ZReadback

name: r_buffer_banksize
description: the bank size in MB for buffer pooling

name: r_buffer_fences
description: Enable waiting on GPU fences for buffer updates

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_dynamic
description: enable/disable runtime defragmentation of dynamic buffers

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_max_moves
description: maximum number of moves the defragmentation system is allowed to perform per frame

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_static
description: enable/disable runtime defragmentation of static buffers

name: r_buffer_pool_max_allocs
description: the maximum number of allocations per buffer pool if defragmentation is enabled

name: r_buffer_sli_workaround
description: enable SLI workaround for buffer pooling

name: r_constantbuffer_banksize
description: the bank size in MB for constant buffers pooling

name: r_constantbuffer_watermarm
description: the threshold aftyer which constants buffers will reclaim memory

name: r_debugCVar1
description: Debug cvar to be used in shaders for testing purposes only

name: r_debugCVar2
description: Debug cvar to be used in shaders for testing purposes only

name: r_debugCVar3
description: Debug cvar to be used in shaders for testing purposes only

name: r_debugCVar4
description: Debug cvar to be used in shaders for testing purposes only

name: r_debugMissingVertexStreams
description: Logs meshes and their shaders which rely on null vertex buffers bound. Ideally, we wouldn't need this.

name: r_debugRendering
description:
Can disable all debug rendering that is currently enabled, in the following way:
0=always disabled
1=disabled during screenshots/trackview-render, otherwise enabled
2=always enabled
NOTE: This CVar is not complete yet. For now, it is working as follows:
1=r_DisplayInfo disabled during g_imageTest* and g_CameraComponentOverrideCaptureCamera screenshots
2=r_DisplayInfo always enabled

name: r_deviceType
description:
Set the type of the device for the Gen12 Renderer.
0 = D3D11Legacy
1 = Vulkan

name: r_displayFrameGraph
description:
Shows a performance graph with basic timings.
The lower gray line is the 16 ms, the upper the 33 ms vsync target.
Yellow: Overall frame time
Green : GPU time
Blue  : CPU render time

name: r_enableAltTab
description:
Toggles alt tabbing in and out of fullscreen when the game is not in devmode.
Usage: r_enableAltTab [toggle]
Notes: Should only be added to system.cfg and requires a restart

name: r_enable_full_gpu_sync
description:
enable full gpu synchronization for debugging purposes on the every buffer I/O operation (debugging only).
0 - Disabled
1 - Loop indefinitely while waiting
2 - Fatal error if waiting more than 'r_full_gpu_sync_timeout' seconds

name: r_excludeDevTeam
description:
Skips the submission of render items from the requested dev team.
Usage: r_excludeDevTeam TeamName
See sys_devteam for allowable team names

name: r_exposureIncidentBlendAmt
description:
Amount of incident lighting for metering modes that blend reflected and incident measurements.
0.0 = Only reflected light
0.5 = Average of reflected and incident light
1.0 = Only incident light

name: r_exposureIncidentMode
description:
Blend amount between incident light measurements at the camera vs in the scene.
0 = At the camera position
1 = At surfaces in the scene

name: r_exposureIncidentNumScenePos
description: Number of positions in the scene where measurements are taken (with r_exposureIncidentMode = 1).

name: r_exposureIncidentNumVectors
description: Number of tiled lighting samples taken at each measurement position.

name: r_exposureIncidentSmoothingTime
description: Seconds taken for incident light measurement to blend halfway towards the current frame's measurement.

name: r_exposureMeterMode
description:
What elements of scene lighting are used for exposure calculations.
0 = reflected light only (average luminance of the scene)
1 = incident light only (illuminance at a spot in front of the camera)
2 = blend of reflected and incident light (controlled by r_exposureIncidentBlendAmt)
3 = same as 2, with clamp on EV compensation based on reflectance of snow and charcoal

name: r_exposureNoiseRatio10EV
description: Scene EV at which sensor noise is low enough to be "acceptable" by ISO standards.

name: r_exposureNoiseRatio40EV
description: Scene EV at which sensor noise is low enough to be "excellent" by ISO standards.

name: r_exposurePerspectiveCorrection
description: Apply weights to exposure calculations for stable results with higher FoVs

name: r_flaresApertureBlades
description: Adjust the number of blades on the aperture.

name: r_flaresApertureRotation
description: Rotate flare ghost images (to simulate aperture blade movement)

name: r_flaresApertureRoundness
description: Adjust the roundness of ghost images (to simulate aperture blade movement)

name: r_full_gpu_sync_timeout
description: sets timeout for full gpu synchronization after which program triggers a fatal error (debugging only)

name: r_glareFilterRatio
description: Compression ratio on luminances over the threshold. E.g. a ratio of 10 will compress dynamic range by 90% (10:1).

name: r_glareFilterThreshold
description: Luminance above which the glare filter activates. Default is 500 kcd/m^2.

name: r_gpuDeviceDebugLog
description:
Set the level of output logging for GPU driver backend systems.
0 = No log output.
1 = All log output.
2 = Backend GPU Device output.
3 = Backend SPIR-V Parse output.
4 = Backend GPU Device Memory output.
5 = GPU Allocator Memory output.
6 = Backend GPU Device Descriptor/Set output.

name: r_hideDebugPBRReference
description: Hide the PBR reference overlay on r_debugGBuffer.

name: r_holograms
description: Enables/disables hologram rendering.

name: r_intromovie
description: Movie to be played waiting for the frontend loading screen

name: r_overrideDXGIAdapter
description:
Specifies index of the preferred video adapter to be used for rendering (-1=off, loops until first suitable adapter is found).
Use this to resolve which video card to use if more than one DX11 capable GPU is available in the system.

name: r_overrideDXGIFullScreenOutput
description:
Defines the preferred monitor for fullscreen display.
Defines the preferred output device for fullscreen display, which can be different from the windowed display device.
Usage: r_PreferredMonitor [0=Main Display Window (default)/(1-n) Monitor index]OBS: the output device must be attached to the selected video card. (see r_overrideDXGIAdapter and r_overrideDXGIOutput)
OBS2: many video cards support up to 2 devices connected, which would make the maximum index be 1.
Usage: r_overrideDXGIFullScreenOutput [0=main display output (default)/(1-n)=display index]

name: r_overrideDXGIOutput
description: Specifies index of display to use for output (0=primary display).

name: r_profileGraph
description:
Shows performance graph for developers.
1 - Plot smoothed times
2 - Plot raw time data
The lower gray line is the 16 ms, the upper the 33 ms vsync target.
Yellow: Overall frame time
Green : GPU time
Blue  : CPU render time
Pink  : Main Thread processing time, if MT is the bottleneck

name: r_profilePipeline
description:
Displays profiler with detailed graphics pipeline and pass timings
0 - Disabled
1 - Pipeline sections with smoothed timings
2 - All pass labels with smoothed timings
3 - All pass labels with raw timings (unstabilized)

name: r_profilePipelineLogProfileGroup
description:
Filter for outputting specific profile group stats to console
Usage: Must have r_profilePipeline enabled, then set r_profilePipelineLogProfileGroup [0 - 32] based on EProfileGroup enum

name: r_scaleform
description: Enables/disables Scaleform rendering.

name: r_shaderCompiler
description:
Specify which Shader Compiler to use for local shader compilation
Usage: r_shaderCompiler [0/1/2]
0 = FXC (default) (D3D11 Usage)
1 = DXC (Vulkan Usage)

name: r_shadersDeadCodeRemoval
description:
Enable removal of dead/unused code by shader parser to reduce size of shader bin and shader compilation time.0 - No code removal
1 - Remove unused FX params
2 - Remove unused FX params & structures & functions

name: r_shadersDisassemble
description:
Enable disassembly from DXC compiled shader. Can be used in conjunction with shadersDebug for varying outputs
Usage: r_shadersDisassemble [0/1]
 0 = Disables the generation of disassembly
 1 = Disassemble SPIRV/DXIL to readable text file in %cache%/shaders/Debug/Disassembly

name: r_shadersEnableExtraCRCChecks
description:
Perform extra checks to see if a shader can avoid being reparsed or recompiled. Only has an effect in editor. Otherwise acts as if set to 0.
0 - Invalidate shader if shader file (including headers before preprocessing) was changed. (Ie if basically anything changed)
1 - Perform extra CRC checks on shader after preprocessing and parsing. Reparse only if shader code after preprocessing has changed, and recompile only if both shader file and shader code after parsing have changed. (Default)

name: r_shadersMaxConcurrentBackgroundCompiles
description:
Maximum amount of concurrent shader compilations on background workers. Default is logicalCores/2. Note that the higher the count the more likely it is that the game will stall due to the fact that all background workers are doing shader compilations and our game is using background workers on the MT.
Any negative number resets it to the default.

name: r_shadersPreloadExts
description: Preload all shader ext files during initialization (takes a few seconds)

name: r_ssdo
description:
Enables Screen Space Directional Occlusion
0 - Disabled
1 - Enabled

name: r_ssdoAmountAmbient
description: Strength of occlusion applied to probe irradiance

name: r_ssdoAmountDirect
description: Strength of occlusion applied to light sources

name: r_ssdoAmountReflection
description: Strength of occlusion applied to probe specular

name: r_ssdoColorBleeding
description:
Enables AO color bleeding to avoid overly dark occlusion on bright surfaces (requires tiled deferred shading)
Usage: r_ssdoColorBleeding [0/1]

name: r_ssdoQuality
description:
Sets the SSDO quality
0 - Standard
1 - Reference mode (unoptimized)

name: r_ssdoRadius
description: Sets the SSDO worldspace radius

name: r_ssdoStrength
description: Allows boosting the AO amount (1.0 is the physically correct base)

name: r_sunshafts
description:
Enables sun shafts.
Usage: r_sunshafts [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 0 to disable.

name: r_testCard
description: Render an image quality test card on the screen.

name: r_texturesStreamingAllowDeferredGPUTextureCreation
description: Enable deferring of GPU texture creation for streamed textures in certain cases, to just before they are needed (allows for some more efficient multithreading)

name: r_texturesStreamingForceCancelReadingDebug
description:
Force cancel already started streaming read tasks.
Usage: r_texturesStreamingForceCancelReadingDebug X. Where X is number of textures that should have started streaming.

name: r_texturesStreamingMinLodBias
description: Minimum fractional LOD bias for textures in resource streamer.

name: r_texturesStreamingNumAttemptsCleanup
description: Number of attempts to allow streaming system to update stream slots before force removing them on cleanup/level unload.

name: r_texturesstreamingDeferred
description: When enabled textures will be uploaded through a deferred context.

name: r_texturesstreamingJobUpdate
description: Enable texture streaming update job

name: r_texturesstreamingMinUsableMips
description: Minimum number of mips a texture should be able to use after applying r_texturesstreamingSkipMips.

name: r_texturesstreamingPostponeThresholdMip
description:
Threshold used to postpone high resolution mipmaps.
Usage: r_texturesstreamingPostponeThresholdMip [count]
Default is 1

name: r_texturesstreamingSkipMips
description: Number of top mips to ignore when streaming.

name: r_transient_pool_size
description: the bank size in MB for the transient pool

name: r_vulkanBatchCommands
description:
Change Vulkan batching of commands at end of frame behaviour.
0 = Single submittal of recorded graphics commands. Comes at a performance cost.
1 = Batches all Graphics commands to be submitted at the end of the frame. (Default).

name: r_vulkanCPUValidation
description:
Enable/Disable CPU validation layers for Vulkan backend.
0 = CPU Validation Layers Disabled (Default)
1 = CPU Validation Layers Core 
2 = CPU Validation Layers Core + Additional Checks 
3 = CPU Validation Layers Synchronization 
4 = CPU Validation Layers Best Practices 
5 = CPU Validation Layers with Profile Emulation

name: r_vulkanCPUValidationMuteID
description:
Comma Seperated List of Vulkan Validation VUIDs to mute and hidden from validation.
Use comma separated list of VUID Numbers or Full VUID Strings, e.g. '01499,BestPractices-NVIDIA-Zcull-LessGreaterRatio,VUID-RuntimeSpirv-OpEntryPoint-08743'

name: r_vulkanCPUValidationSeverity
description:
Change Vulkan Validation message reporting severity.
1 = Emit Errors (Default)
2 = Emit Errors + Warnings 
3 = Emit Errors + Warnings + Performance 
4 = Emit All

name: r_vulkanDeviceCheckpoints
description:
Enable/Disable Vulkan Checkpoint markup/insertion for GPU crash debugging.
0 = Vulkan Device Checkpoints Disabled (Default) 
1 = Vulkan Device Checkpoints Enabled

name: r_vulkanForceDebugExtension
description:
Enable/Disable Debug Utils Extension for Vulkan backend.
0 = VK Debug Utils only enabled when required
1 = VK Debug Utils always on (useful when using external tools)

name: r_vulkanGPUValidation
description:
Enable/Disable GPU Assisted Validation for Vulkan Backend.
0 = GPU Assisted Validation Disabled
1 = GPU Assisted Validation Enabled

name: r_vulkanHWRTExtraDescriptors
description: Extra descriptor pool space to reserve to allow the hardware RT list of buffers to fit

name: r_vulkanLoaderDebug
description: enable full verbose debug output for the vulkan loader.

name: r_vulkanOutputCommandSync
description: enable full synchronization of Vulkan rendering and computing commands for debugging purposes.

name: r_vulkanPSOCache
description:
Enables using PSO Cache for Vulkan.
0 = PSO creation doesn't use cache.
1 = PSO creation uses cache.

name: r_vulkanPSOCacheLoad
description:
Attempt to load vulkan PSO cache on startup.
0 = PSO cache is fresh every run.
1 = Attempt to load PSO cache when possible. (Default).

name: r_vulkanProfileEmulation
description:
Try to emulate capabilities of another machine for Vulkan (useful for validaton)
AUTO                = VP_CIG_BASE_DLSS if validation is enabled, NO_PROFILE otherwiseNO_PROFILE          = None, do not overrideVP_CIG_BASE         = Base config for developmentVP_CIG_BASE-DLSS    = Base config for development (with DLSS)VP_CIG_BASE-RT      = Base config for development (with RT)VP_CIG_BASE-RT-DLSS = Base config for development (with RT+DLSS)

name: r_wireframe
description:
Can be used to globally set the polygon mode: 
0 (Default): Polygon mode used from Drawcallpackets 
1: Line mode 
2: Point mode

name: region_id
description: Region id. 0:Any, 1:US, 2:Europe, 3:Oceania, 4: Asia, 5: Expansion (for further use)

name: rm_atmosphereShowMutablity
description: Option to draw immutable atmosphere containers as red when debugging. [0=off/1=show]

name: rm_atmospherefogDensityMultiplier
description: Multiplier for the density of the fog volume controlled by atmosphere containers

name: rm_behaviorList
description: List the behaviours affecting your current position for each room

name: rm_debug_atmosphere_extra_log_filter
description: Substring to match for atmosphere container entity name to show additional atmosphere debug logging for that entity.

name: rm_debug_atmosphere_sphere_size
description: Modifies the size of spheres indicating atmospheres in room. Default value is: 0.5

name: rm_debug_connector
description: Toggles debugging info for nearby room connectors and draws them as yellow boxes. Usage: rm_debug_room [0=off/1=show]

name: rm_debug_connector_extra_log_filter
description: Substring to match for connector entity name to show additional connector debug logging for that entity.

name: rm_debug_draw_atmosphere_inheritance_links
description: Determines whether to include atmosphere inheritance links in the debug visualization shown by room_debug_draw. On if > 0.

name: rm_debug_extra_log_filter
description: Substring to match for room entity name to show additional room debug logging for that entity.

name: rm_debug_gas_producer_consumer
description:
Toggles debugging info for entities which consumes/produces gas, ie. something that breathes oxygen. Usage: rm_debug_gas_producer_consumer [0=off/1=show]
Set rm_debug_room_system_near_dist = 0 to debug self

name: rm_debug_occupant_extra_log_filter
description: Substring to match for occupant entity name to show additional debug logging for that entity.

name: rm_debug_room
description: Toggles debugging rendering for nearby rooms. Usage: rm_debug_room [0=off/1=show].

name: rm_debug_room_draw_filled
description: If > 1 causes room debug visualization to show solid shapes rather than wireframe

name: rm_debug_room_extension_filter
description:
Optional filter for room extension info display, matches substring in extension types. 
Example: "rm_debug_room_extension_filter Jurisdiction" (room extensions only shows info for the IJurisdictionRoomExtension extension)

name: rm_debug_room_graph
description: Toggles room graph debug rendering. Usage: rm_debug_room_graph [0=off/1=show].

name: rm_debug_room_legacy
description: Toggles legacy drawing of text for nearby rooms. Prefer using the Room System DebugGUI tool if possible. Usage: rm_debug_room_legacy [0=off/1=show].

name: rm_debug_room_overlaps_verbosity
description:
Determines the verbosity of rm_debug_debug.rm_find_overlapping_rooms. Recommended to set to 3 when looking for potential markup errors.
If this is > 0 the behaviour of rm_debug.room is overriden to show room overlap debugging info rather than atmospheric composition.0: off
1: Show only definite overlaps between rooms comprised entirely of box areas.
2: Also show probable overlaps between rooms made of complex shapes.
3: Also show warnings for rooms that appear to be nested correctly but the algorithm can't be certain.
4: Also show notifications for rooms that ARE properly nested. Not recommended due to spam.

name: rm_debug_room_system
description: Toggle debug info for the current (client) or all connected (server) players. [0=off/1=show]

name: rm_debug_room_system_far_dist
description: The maximum distance from a room object (room, connector, producer/consumer) the camera needs to be in order to draw the debug info. Default: 200

name: rm_debug_room_system_near_dist
description: The minimum distance from a room object (room, connector, producer/consumer) the camera needs to be in order to draw the debug info. Default: 0.01

name: rm_debug_room_system_planet_far_dist
description: The maximum distance from a planet room the camera needs to be in order to draw the debug info. Default: 4000000

name: rm_debug_room_system_show_atmosphere_for_position
description: Toggle to show the output of rm_debug_room_system positional atmospheric properties instead of total. [0=off/1=show]

name: rm_debug_room_system_simple_dist
description: The maximum distance from a room object(room, connector, producer / consumer) the camera needs to be in order to draw some simplified debug info. Default: 15

name: rm_enableDynamicAtmosphere
description:
Allow dynamic atmosphere features, including gas propagation and life support.
 0: Force off 
1: Use gamemode value. 
2: Force on.
Note that this CVar is intended to be set via user.cfg, changing it at runtime may not have the full effect as entities only read it when they are initializing.

name: rm_graph_deferredMapLoadTimeLimit
description: Max time to spend loading room graphs per frame (ms).

name: rm_graph_update_time
description: Delay between room markup edits and the room graph updating.  If 0, doesn't update.

name: rm_lifeSupportRequiresResources
description: Whether or not life support requires resources to operate. Default = 1 YES, set to 0 for NO

name: rm_max_room_graph_subgraphs_for_export
description: Maximum number of subgraphs to export in an OC - if above this the data will not be exported at all.

name: rm_player_local_room_cache_depth
description: Maximum depth of rooms to cache per player.

name: rm_propertyCalculations
description: Show how a property is calculated for the client player at the current position

name: rm_propertyDebug
description: List the final values of each property for the client player at the current position, use higher values to show steps up the room stack

name: rm_propertyParticles
description: Show a visual debug of the strength for each property

name: rm_rainHumidityEnabled
description: Enable overriding the humidity when the planet weather system outputs rain values

name: rm_rainHumidityMaximum
description: The maximum humidity override to output when the planet weather system outputs rain values

name: rm_rainHumidityMinimum
description: The minimum humidity override to output when the planet weather system outputs rain values

name: s_AreaQueryMaxDistance
description: Max radius of area query (i.e. max fade distance of areas) Default: 50m

name: s_AudioEventPoolSize
description:
Sets the number of preallocated audio events.
Usage: s_AudioEventPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 256, XboxOne: 256, PS4: 256, Linux: 256

name: s_AudioObjectPoolSize
description:
Sets the number of preallocated audio objects and corresponding audio proxies.
Usage: s_AudioObjectPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 512, XboxOne: 512, PS4: 512, Linux: 512

name: s_AudioProxiesInitType
description:
Can override AudioProxies' init type on a global scale.
If set it determines whether AudioProxies initialize synchronously or asynchronously.
This is a performance type cvar as asynchronously initializing AudioProxies
will have a greatly reduced impact on the calling thread.
Be aware though that when set to initialize asynchronously that audio will play back delayed.
By how much will greatly depend on the audio thread's work load.
0: AudioProxy specific initialization.
1: All AudioProxies initialize synchronously.
2: All AudioProxies initialize asynchronously.
Usage: s_AudioProxiesInitType [0/1/2]
Default PC: 0, XboxOne: 0, PS4: 0, Linux: 0

name: s_AudioSystemImplementationName
description:
Holds the name of the AudioSystemImplementation library to be used.
Usage: s_AudioSystemImplementationName <name of the library without extension>
Default: CryAudioImplWwise

name: s_CaptureAllWwiseRequests
description: Enable capture of all wwise commands to [USER]/audio_command_requests.xml.

name: s_DefaultMultiPositionType
description:
Indicates the default multi position type, for audio objects which don't have the multi position type explicitly set.
1 = eAMPT_MULTISOURCES
2 = eAMPT_MULTIDIRECTIONS
Usage: s_DefaultMultiPositionType 1|2
Default: 2

name: s_DropListener
description:
Drop default listener at current location.
Usage: s_DropListener [0..1]
0: Disabled
1: Enabled (client entity zone mode). Default listener's location will remain at location it was 'dropped' within the client entity's zone.
   (good for dropping the listener in a ship or on a planet surface)2: Enabled (world position mode). Default listener's location will remain at location it was 'dropped' in world space.
   (good for dropping the listener in space and testing passbys)

name: s_DynamicRangePreset
description:
Set dynamic range preset [0,1,2]
 0 is MINIMUM RANGE (full compression)
1 is MEDIUM RANGE (moderate compression)
2 is FULL RANGE (no compression).

name: s_EnablePropagationPathing
description: If set to 1, propagation is enabled.  2 is actors only.

name: s_EnableSecondaryOutput
description: If true, enables the secondary (headset) output in wwise.

name: s_FileCacheManagerSize
description:
Sets the size in KiB the AFCM will allocate on the heap.
Usage: s_FileCacheManagerSize [0/...]
Default PC: 2048 (2 MiB), XboxOne: 393216 (384 MiB), PS4: 393216 (384 MiB), Linux: 393216 (384 MiB), WiiU: 131072 (128 MiB)

name: s_FullObstructionMaxDistance
description:
for the sounds, whose distance to the listener is greater than this value, the obstruction is value gets attenuated with distance.
Usage: s_FullObstructionMaxDistance [0/...]
Default: 5 m

name: s_IgnoreWindowFocus
description:
If set to 1, the sound system will continue playing when the Editor or Game window loses focus.
Usage: s_IgnoreWindowFocus [0/1]
Default: 0 (off)

name: s_ListenerDebugSphereAlpha
description:
Set or modify the transparency of the listener sphere.
Usage: s_ListenerDebugSphereRadius [float]
Default alpha: 0.5

name: s_ListenerDebugSphereRadius
description:
Set or modify the sphere size of the listener.
Usage: s_ListenerDebugSphereRadius [float]
Default size: 20.0

name: s_LoadGlobalBanksBlocking
description:
Specifies whether all global banks will block the main thread when loading.
Usage: s_LoadGlobalBanksBlocking [0/1]
Default PC: 0 - asynchronous operation, NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_MixLevelMaster
description: Sets master volume of all audio output on the primary bus (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelMusic
description: Sets volume of music (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelSfx
description: Sets volume of sound effects (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelShipComputerSpeech
description: Sets volume of ship computer speech (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelSimulationAnnouncer
description: Sets volume of simulation announcer (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelSpeech
description: Sets volume of speech (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelTTS
description: Sets volume of TTS (0..1).

name: s_MixLevelVOIP
description: Sets volume of VOIP received (0..1).

name: s_OcclusionMaxDistance
description:
Obstruction/Occlusion is not calculated for the sounds whose distance to the listener is greater than this value. Setting this value to 0 disables obstruction/occlusion calculations.
Usage: s_OcclusionMaxDistance [0/...]
Default: 500 m

name: s_OcclusionMaxSyncDistance
description:
Physics rays are processed synchronously for the sounds that are closer to the listener than this value, and asynchronously for the rest (possible performance optimization).
Usage: s_OcclusionMaxSyncDistance [0/...]
Default: 10 m

name: s_PanningRule
description: Set audio panning rule [0,1]. 0: Pan for speakers, with left and right positioned 60 degrees apart. 1: Pan for headphones, with left and right positioned 180 degrees apart.

name: s_PositionUpdateThreshold
description:
An audio object has to move by at least this amount to issue a position update request to the audio system.
This kind of optimization should ideally be done by the parent system so this is here for convenience.Usage: s_PositionUpdateThreshold [0/...]
Default: 0.1 (10 cm)

name: s_PreferredAudioInputDeviceHash
description:
Indicates the preferred audio input device, via the hash of it's identifier.
Usage: s_PreferredAudioInputDeviceHash <Hash of Audio Device ID>
Default: 0 - which means use the default device as indicated by the Operating System
NB: If a specified device is not present then the default device will be used instead

name: s_RtpcStepCount
description: Number of valid steps for the RTPC value.  Changes below the step size won't be sent to the Implementation.

name: s_ShipComputerVerbosityPreset
description: Ship computer verbosity preset index.

name: s_SpeakerSetting
description: Internal speaker setting - accessed via pause menu.

name: s_SubmixRecordersDebugMode
description:
If set to 1, will provide debug logging for submix recorder actions.
If set to 2, in addition to the debug logging, will create a wav file each time the plugin is instantiated on a bus.
Will also output a message to the Wwise profiler every time a plugin is instantiated.

name: s_SubmixRecordersEnabled
description: If true, enables submix recording using the CIG Submix Recorder plugin.

name: s_SubmixRecordersMuteOutput
description: If true, submix recorders act as sinks and don't pass audio.

name: s_UseInstancedZoneCullingV2
description: Safety CVar for late 4.0 change

name: s_UseSyncMode
description: Audio processing is executed on the Main Thread when set to 1, otherwise it uses the CryEngine AudioThreadUsage: s_UseSyncMode 0 or 1Default: 0

name: s_WwiseCommandQueueSize
description:
Specifies the size (in KiB) of the Wwise command queue.
Usage: s_WwiseCommandQueueSize [0/...]
Default PC: 8192 (8M), NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_WwiseMaxMemorySize
description:
Specifies the maximum size (in KB) that the Wwise audio system implementation will allocate dynamically.
When allocations reach this size, audio will be negatively affected, leading to missing sounds etc.
Usage: s_WwiseMaxMemorySize [0/...]
Default PC: 1GB, Xbox360: 0 , XboxOne: 0, PS3: 0, PS4: 0, Linux: 0

name: s_WwiseNumRefillsInVoice
description:
Number of refill buffers in voice buffer. 2 == double-buffered, defaults to 4.
Usage: s_WwiseNumRefillsInVoice [2/3/4]
Default PC: 4, NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_WwiseNumSamplesPerFrame
description:
Number of samples per audio frame (256, 512, 1024, or 2048)
Usage: s_WwiseNumSamplesPerFrame [256/512/1024/2048]
Default PC: 1024, NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_WwiseSecondaryPoolSize
description:
Specifies the size (in KiB) of the memory pool to be used by the Wwise audio system implementation.
Usage: s_WwiseSecondaryPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 0, Xbox360: 32768 (32 MiB), XboxOne: 32768 (32 MiB), PS3: 0, PS4: 0, Linux: 0

name: s_WwiseSeparateEngineThreadPriority
description:
Specifies the thread priority when Wwise uses its own thread for audio processing.
Usage: s_WwiseSeparateEngineThreadPriority [0/1/2]
Default PC: 1 (Highest), NA for other platforms ATM.  Other options: 0 (Above Normal), 2 (Time Critical)

name: s_WwiseStreamDeviceIOPoolSize
description:
Size (in KiB) of the stream device IO pool size.
Usage: s_WwiseStreamDeviceIOPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 16mb, NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_WwiseUseSeparateEngineThread
description:
Specifies whether Wwise should use its own thread or run on the AudioThread.
Usage: s_WwiseUseSeparateEngineThread [0/1]
Default PC: 1(use a separate thread), NA for other platforms ATM

name: s_allowFlowAudioPlaybackOnGlobalObject
description: Allow Flowgraph Audio playback on global object.  Default: 0

name: s_cameraViewFStopOverwrite

name: s_debugCameraFOVLensSize

name: s_enableOperatorShake

name: s_enableRaceCommentary

name: s_enableRaycastForClientFootsteps

name: s_entitlementEntityCreator.enableOfflineItemsEntitlement

name: s_localPlayerAudio.PlayerAttackedRtpcCountdown

name: s_localPlayerAudio.RealisticModeAmount
description: Sets the realistic mode effect level.

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.EarlyReflectionsLevel
description:
Wet level of early reflections.
[Default is 0.25]

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.RayLength
description: Sets the max distance for the player actor rays.

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.RaysPerFrame
description: Sets the amount of rays per frame for the player actor.

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.SphereRayCount
description: Sets the amount of rays if a Fibonacci sphere is used for the player actor. Must be multiples of 2!

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.SphereType
description: 0: Fibonacci sphere, 1: 60 point truncated icosahedron.

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.WallaEnabled
description:
If set to 1 the Walla system will be enabled.
[Default is 0]

name: s_localPlayerEnvironment.WaveHeightCalculationsEnabled
description:
If 1, listenerUnderwaterRtpc will use accurate wave calculations as opposed to ocean radius.
[Default is 0]

name: s_oceanAudio.audioPositionSnapDistance

name: s_oceanAudio.windThreshold

name: s_oneShotManager.debugEnabledDetails

name: s_oneShotManager.filter

name: s_oneShotManager.textSize
description: Text size.

name: s_physical.CONTINUOUS_CONTACT_ACTIVE_FRAMES

name: s_physical.CONTINUOUS_CONTACT_IDLE_FRAMES

name: s_physical.FAKE_MASS_TERRAIN

name: s_valueOutputManager.debugEnabled

In the client this is always interpreted as 0 as we always want blocking conversions.

2=filter file

defines the verbosity level for log messages written to console

0=suppress all logs(except eAlways)

2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

-1=suppress all logs (including eAlways)
