2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

-1=suppress all logs (including eAlways)
0=suppress all logs(except eAlways)
1=additional errors
2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

defines the verbosity level for log messages published to cigTrace

-1=suppress all logs (including eAlways)
0=suppress all logs(except eAlways)
1=additional errors
2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

name: v_ifcs2.limiters_linear_type
description:
Changed the used limiter type: 
-1: as defined 
0: NormalizedUniform (stable velocity vector - allows trichording)
1: NormalizedUniformWithMaxRadius (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with max radius - no trichording)
2: NormalizedUniformLateral (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with lateral priority - no trichording)
3: Ellipsoid (stronger cut back off accelerations (stable, strongest cut back on accels)
4  PerAxis (unstable, does not keep velocity vector, allows trichording) 
5  PerAxisWithMaxRadius (unstable, prefers longitudinal, no trichording) 
6: PerAxisLateral (unstable, prefers lateral, no trichording, if longitudinal axis is smaller than lateral axes, ellipsoid is used)

name: v_ifcs2.limiters_pitch_yaw_acceleration
description:
-1: as defined 
0: NormalizedUniform (allows 45s)
1: NormalizedUniformWithMaxRadius (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with max radius - no 45s)
2: NormalizedUniformLateral (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with lateral priority - no 45s)
3: Ellipsoid (stronger cut back off accelerations (stable, strongest cut back on accels)
4  PerAxis (unstable, does not keep velocity vector, allows trichording) 
5  PerAxisWithMaxRadius (unstable, prefers longitudinal, no trichording) 
6: PerAxisLateral (unstable, prefers lateral, no trichording. should not be used for pitch yaw)

name: v_ifcs2.limiters_pitch_yaw_velocity
description:
-1: as defined 
0: NormalizedUniform (allows 45s)
1: NormalizedUniformWithMaxRadius (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with max radius - no 45s)
2: NormalizedUniformLateral (stable velocity vector, like 1 but with lateral priority - no 45s)
3: Ellipsoid (stronger cut back off accelerations (stable, strongest cut back on accels)
4  PerAxis (unstable, does not keep velocity vector, allows trichording) 
5  PerAxisWithMaxRadius (unstable, prefers longitudinal, no trichording) 
6: PerAxisLateral (unstable, prefers lateral, no trichording, should not be used for pitch yaw)

name: w_regen_pool.enable_assignment_modifier_on_regen
description: Enables regen modifier based on capacitor assignments.

name: w_regen_pool.hack_pipe_value_modifier
description: Hack value to multiply/divide pipe values by for weapon regen/ammo load, so errors are below an epsilon (0.001) and get ignored properly.

name: w_salvage_ammo_change_interval
description: Time in seconds between ammo updates from the salvage / repair weapon action. Used to reduce bandwidth usage.

name: w_salvage_enable_item_repair
description: Enables or disables salvage repair beams being able to repair the health of items without damage maps that have been set to be repairable in Dataforge.

name: w_send_duplicated_commands
description: If 0, the weapon will not sync duplicated commands over the network. A command is marked as duplicated if it triggered in the same tick with the same data.

name: w_skip_local_simulation_threshold_time
description: Skips ahead in the simulation if the last update tick older than this in seconds, if it is above zero.

name: w_tractor_maxQueryRange
description: Every entity beyond that distance in meters will not be considered for port checks.

name: w_tractor_range_validation
description: Enable or disable server sided range validation for the tractorbeam.

name: w_tractor_requires_lift_force_to_move
description: If true the player can never move an entity if it requires more force to lift than the tractor beam can provide. If false the player can move entities along the ground even if there's not enough available force to lift it in the air.

name: w_tractor_speed_validation
description: Enable or disable server sided speed validation for the tractorbeam.

name: w_tractor_validation_distance_modifier
description: Defines how much leeway we give to the validation checks.

name: watch_enabled
description: On-screen watch text is enabled/disabled

name: watch_text_render_fxscale
description: Draw2d label to IFFont x scale value (for calcing sizes).

name: watch_text_render_lineSpacing
description: On-screen watch text line spacing (to cram more text on screen without shrinking the font)

name: watch_text_render_size
description: On-screen watch text render size

name: watch_text_render_start_pos_x
description: On-screen watch text render start x position

name: watch_text_render_start_pos_y
description: On-screen watch text render start y position

name: weapon_bob_override.debug
description: Enable prototype weapon bob debug 1-enable 0-disable

name: weapon_bob_override.enable
description: Enable prototype weapon bob which is in sync with foots 1-enable 0-disable

name: weapon_bob_override.footstepsCycleDelay
description: prototype weapon bob footstepsCycleDelay

name: weapon_bob_override.maxSpeed
description: Max speed for weapon sync

name: widget.chat.visor.init.retries
description: The ammount of retries to initialize the visor chat
